job_description: Position Summary The Assistant CHW Supervisor will support the supervision, coordination, and day-to-day management of Community Health Workers (CHWs) working under the Primary Health Care Centre (PHCC) in the Rohingya Response, Cox’s Bazar. The position holder will support the implementation of community-based health activities, including health promotion, disease prevention, health education, community mobilization, identification and referral of vulnerable and sick individuals, follow-up of referred cases, and dissemination of key health messages. The Assistant CHW Supervisor will provide day-to-day guidance, mentoring, and supportive supervision to assign CHWs and support the CHW Supervisor/Community Health Officer in planning, monitoring, reporting, and coordinating community health activities. The position holder needs to visit houses at least 3 days a week. The position holder will work closely with the CHW Supervisor, Clinical Coordinator, Medical Officer Lead, Medical Officers, Nursing Team, Midwifery Team, IPC, Surveillance, Nutrition, MHPSS, Protection, WASH, and other relevant teams to strengthen the link between the community and PHCC services and promote timely access to healthcare. Duty Station:  Camp 5, Ukhiya, Cox’s Bazar Reports to:  CHW Supervisor Accountable to:  Deputy Project Coordinator KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY: CHW Supervision & Team Support Provide day-to-day supervision and support to assigned Community Health Workers (CHWs). Support the implementation of CHW work plans and daily activities. Conduct regular supportive supervision and field monitoring. Provide guidance and practical support to CHWs during community activities. Monitor CHW attendance, punctuality, and assigned responsibilities. Facilitate community to capture lesson learnt, case stories. Support appropriate allocation of CHWs to designated communities or areas. Escalate significant performance or operational concerns to the CHW Supervisor. Promote teamwork, accountability, professionalism, and respectful behaviour among CHWs. Community Health Education & Promotion Build capacity of the CHWs on the messages to share with the community. Support CHWs in conducting community health education and awareness activities. Ensure CHWs provide accurate, approved, and culturally appropriate health messages. Promote key health topics, including: o	Personal hygiene and handwashing. o	Safe water and sanitation. o	Communicable disease prevention. o	Maternal and child health. o	Nutrition. o	Immunization awareness. o	Prevention and early identification of common diseases. o	Infection Prevention and Control (IPC). o	Health-seeking behaviour. o	Appropriate use of PHCC services. Support community awareness sessions and group discussions. Ensure health education messages are consistent with approved organizational and health sector guidance. Community Mobilization & PHCC Linkage Support community mobilization to promote access to PHCC services. Strengthen communication between the community and PHCC. Support CHWs in identifying barriers to healthcare access. Encourage appropriate and timely health-seeking behaviour. Promote awareness of available PHCC services. Support dissemination of information regarding service availability and schedules. Support community mobilization during health campaigns and special activities. Communicate community concerns and feedback to relevant PHCC teams. Identification & Referral of Patients Support CHWs in identifying individuals with health concerns requiring further assessment. Ensure CHWs recognize basic danger signs and referral criteria according to approved guidance. Support timely referral of sick or vulnerable individuals to the PHCC or other appropriate services. Ensure CHWs do not provide clinical diagnosis or treatment beyond their approved scope. Support communication between CHWs and PHCC teams regarding urgent referrals. Follow up on referred individuals where appropriate. Monitor referral completion and identify barriers. Ensure appropriate documentation of referrals. Follow-Up of Referred Cases Support CHWs in following up on individuals referred to PHCC services. Encourage patients and caregivers to complete recommended referrals. Identify barriers preventing individuals from accessing healthcare. Communicate significant follow-up concerns to the relevant supervisor or clinical team. Maintain appropriate referral and follow-up records. Support continuity of care through appropriate community-level follow-up. Ensure patient confidentiality during follow-up activities. Disease Surveillance & Community Alerts Support CHWs in identifying and reporting unusual health events. Promote timely reporting of suspected disease outbreaks and unusual health concerns. Support CHWs in identifying potential clusters of illness or unusual increases in cases. Ensure community health alerts are communicated promptly to the CHW Supervisor and Surveillance team. Support event-based and community-based surveillance activities as assigned. Assist with community-level follow-up during public health alerts. Maintain confidentiality and avoid spreading unverified information. Support for Outbreak Response Support community health activities during disease outbreaks and public health emergencies. Assist in disseminating approved outbreak prevention and control messages. Support community mobilization during outbreak response activities. Coordinate with Surveillance and IPC teams as required. Support CHWs in identifying and reporting suspected cases according to approved procedures. Assist in promoting appropriate health-seeking and referral behaviour. Participate in emergency response activities as assigned. Community-Based Infection Prevention & Control Support CHWs in promoting key community-level IPC practices. Promote hand hygiene and respiratory hygiene. Support health education on prevention of communicable diseases. Disseminate approved information regarding infection prevention. Coordinate with the IPC team regarding community IPC messages. Support community awareness activities during outbreaks. Ensure CHWs provide consistent and accurate IPC information. Community Feedback & Accountability Support the collection of community feedback regarding health services. Identify common concerns, barriers, and suggestions from community members. Communicate relevant feedback to the CHW Supervisor and appropriate PHCC teams. Support appropriate follow-up of community concerns. Promote respectful and responsive communication with community members. Support awareness of available feedback and complaint mechanisms. Ensure sensitive concerns are handled according to organizational procedures. Coordination with Multidisciplinary Teams Work closely with the CHW Supervisor and relevant PHCC teams. Coordinate with Medical, Nursing, Midwifery, Nutrition, MHPSS, IPC, Surveillance, WASH, and Protection teams. Support integrated health promotion and community outreach activities. Communicate community-level health concerns to relevant service providers. Participate in coordination meetings when required. Support referral and follow-up between community and facility services. Promote effective teamwork and communication. CHW Training & Capacity Building Support orientation of newly recruited CHWs. Assist in organizing refresher training sessions. Provide regular on-the-job coaching and mentoring. Support training on: o	Health promotion. o	Community engagement. o	Referral procedures. o	Recognition of danger signs. o	Basic disease prevention. o	IPC. o	Community surveillance. o	Confidentiality and professional conduct. o	Safeguarding and PSEA. Identify CHW knowledge and skills gaps. Maintain training and coaching records. Monitoring & Field Supervision Conduct regular field monitoring of CHW activities. Observe health education sessions and community engagement activities. Monitor the quality and accuracy of health messages. Review CHW activity records and reports. Verify selected reported activities where required. Provide constructive feedback to CHWs. Document monitoring findings and follow up on improvement actions. Report significant issues to the CHW Supervisor. Data Collection, Documentation & Reporting Support CHWs in maintaining accurate activity records. Collect and review CHW activity reports. Check reports for completeness and consistency. Support compilation of daily, weekly, and monthly CHW activity data. Maintain records of referrals, follow-up, health education sessions, and community activities. Support preparation of routine reports. Report significant community health concerns promptly. Maintain confidentiality of community and patient information. Supplies & Materials Management Support monitoring of CHW supplies and health education materials. Ensure CHWs have access to approved IEC/BCC materials. Monitor the appropriate use and distribution of materials. Maintain basic records of materials issued to CHWs. Identify shortages and report them promptly. Support replenishment of approved materials. Ensure proper accountability of organizational resources. Safeguarding, PSEA & Protection Promote safeguarding and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) among CHWs. Ensure CHWs understand and follow organizational safeguarding policies. Promote respectful and non-discriminatory engagement with community members. Ensure CHWs maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries. Identify and report safeguarding concerns through approved reporting mechanisms. Promote awareness of available complaint and feedback mechanisms. Ensure community activities are conducted safely and respectfully. Emergency Preparedness & Humanitarian Response Support CHW preparedness for humanitarian emergencies. Assist in mobilizing CHWs during disease outbreaks, fires, natural disasters, or other emergencies. Support rapid dissemination of approved emergency health messages. Assist in identifying vulnerable individuals requiring support. Support community-level emergency preparedness activities. Participate in emergency response activities as assigned. Remain flexible to undertake additional responsibilities based on programme requirements. Additional Job Responsibilities The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive. Support coordination with programme, facility, Epidemiology, and other relevant teams on routine reporting requirements. Programme Monitoring Support Support the MIS Manager and programme team in tracking progress against project indicators and targets. Maintain indicator tracking tools and programme monitoring databases. Support routine review of health service delivery and programme performance.. Assist in the preparation of programme monitoring reports, presentations and data summaries. Support assessments, surveys, and other data collection activities as required. Coordinate with the MEAL team to ensure consistency between programme, monitoring, and reporting data. Support verification of reported achievements using source documents and other available evidence. Provide routine data and analysis for programme review meetings and performance monitoring. Flag significant performance gaps or data inconsistencies to the MIS Manager and relevant programme staff. Data Visualization & Information Products Develop and regularly update dashboards, charts, graphs and summary tables under the guidance of the MIS Manager. Ensure dashboards and visual products use validated data and agreed indicators. Update and maintain routine dashboards according to agreed reporting schedules. Support the development and improvement of automated reporting and data visualisation tools where possible. Prepare user-friendly information products for management review and programme decision-making. Support the preparation of presentations, situation updates, and other reporting materials. Present key data trends and findings in a clear and understandable format. Support the development and improvement of automated reporting and data visualization tools where possible. Owns the handover between the clinical decision on optimal service hours and the client service team, so no family waits because of an internal gap. Verifies that supervision and parent meetings are delivered at the frequency each package entitles the family to, and that reports reach the family. Maintains working collaboration between the clinical departments, so that a child receiving more than one service is treated as one case with shared goals rather than three separate programmes, and resolves cross-departmental clinical conflicts before they escalate. Removes clinical causes of drop-off, in particular late reports, unclear service recommendations and delayed assessment decisions. Participates in clinical interviews and competency assessment, and works with the clinical leads to define the standard a candidate must meet. Supports the clinical onboarding and probation of new therapists, so that a new hire reaches a productive caseload without avoidable delay. Runs the monitoring routine at both centres and maintains the required observation counts for each discipline. Triages every incident, drives it to closure within the target for its level, escalates critical matters immediately and acts on recurrence triggers. Maintains the clinical document set, version controlled and reviewed on cycle. Ensures timely reporting across clinical operations, quality and monitoring, submitted to the DGM on schedule and in a form ready to go forward. Ensures audit and inspection non-conformities relating to clinical delivery are closed by the agreed date. Client retention and experience Maintains the at-risk client register from progress data, attendance, cancellations and complaint history, and ensures each flagged family receives a documented clinical intervention. Conducts root cause analysis on every discontinuation and separates clinical causes from commercial, relocation and planned discharge. Owns the corrective action where the cause is clinical, including programme review, therapist change and additional supervision. Owns the clinical side of the family experience: report quality, the usefulness of supervision and parent meetings, and consistency when a cover therapist is assigned. Ensures that what is promised to a family is recorded and delivered, and that where it cannot be, the family is told before the deadline rather than after. Ensures timely reporting of discontinuation by discipline, cause and active caseload, so the organisation reads rates rather than counts. Works with the DGM-Operations to plan the clinical seminar calendar, and participates in sessions as an organiser, presenter and attendee rather than only arranging them. New service implementation Works under the DGM, who leads new service implementation, on the clinical design and delivery of new services, disciplines and centre lines through to steady-state handover. Produces the clinical readiness package for the DGM before launch: protocol, standard operating procedure, staffing and competency requirement, session and supervision model, documentation and clinical inputs to pricing. Verifies staff competency before any client is enrolled, runs the pilot and reports to the DGM on what should be changed, continued or stopped. job_description: কর্মস্থল:  উত্তরা, সেক্টর ৩, ঢাকা – ১২৩০ কর্মঘণ্টা:  সকাল ৯:০০ টা – সন্ধ্যা ৭:০০ টা (শুক্রবার সাপ্তাহিক ছুটি) কাজের দায়িত্বসমূহ: বিল ও চালান প্রস্তুতকরণ:  কোম্পানির সকল বিক্রয় বিল, ক্রয় বিল, চালান, ডেলিভারি নোট ও সংশ্লিষ্ট কাগজপত্র নির্ভুলভাবে প্রস্তুত ও যাচাই করা। তথ্য ও মূল্য যাচাই:  প্রতিটি বিলে পণ্যের নাম, পরিমাণ, একক মূল্য, ভ্যাট-ট্যাক্স এবং মোট হিসাব সঠিক আছে কি না তা অনুমোদিত কোটেশন বা পারচেজ অর্ডারের সাথে মিলিয়ে নিশ্চিত করা। অসঙ্গতি সংশোধন:  বিলে কোনো ভুল, অসঙ্গতি বা অতিরিক্ত চার্জ ধরা পড়লে তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা এবং অনুমোদন সাপেক্ষে সংশোধন করা। পণ্য নিরীক্ষা:  ডেলিভারির পূর্বে পণ্যের বিবরণ, সাইজ, রং, পরিমাণ, প্যাকেজিং এবং অনুমোদিত নমুনার সাথে মূল পণ্য সতর্কতার সাথে মিলিয়ে দেখা। ডেলিভারি সমন্বয় ও পরিকল্পনা:  দৈনিক ডেলিভারি শিডিউল তৈরি করা এবং সঠিক সময়ে পণ্য পৌঁছানোর জন্য ডেলিভারি ম্যান, কুরিয়ার/পরিবহনকারী এবং গ্রাহকের সাথে সার্বক্ষণিক যোগাযোগ রক্ষা করা। প্রাপ্তিস্বীকারপত্র সংগ্রহ:  পণ্য ডেলিভারির পর গ্রাহকের স্বাক্ষর ও সিলসহ মূল চালান বা প্রাপ্তিস্বীকারপত্র (Proof of Delivery) সংগ্রহ নিশ্চিত করা। সমস্যা সমাধান:  কোনো পণ্য কম, ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত বা ভুল ডেলিভারি হলে দ্রুত কর্তৃপক্ষকে জানানো এবং প্রয়োজনীয় সমাধানের ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া। পেমেন্ট ও বকেয়া ফলোআপ:  বকেয়া বিল ও পেমেন্টের অবস্থা নিয়মিত ট্র্যাক করা এবং আপডেট তথ্য কর্তৃপক্ষকে প্রদান করা। নথি ও রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ:  সকল চালান, বিল, রিসিট এবং ডেলিভারি সংক্রান্ত নথিপত্র তারিখ ও গ্রাহক অনুযায়ী যথাযথভাবে সংরক্ষণ ও ফাইলভুক্ত করা। প্রতিবেদন প্রদান:  দৈনিক, সাপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক বিলিং এবং ডেলিভারির বিস্তারিত রিপোর্ট কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট উপস্থাপন করা। অন্যান্য দায়িত্ব:  কোম্পানির সকল গ্রাহক তথ্য ও আর্থিক হিসাবের সর্বোচ্চ গোপনীয়তা রক্ষা করা এবং কর্তৃপক্ষের অনুমোদন ছাড়া কোনো আর্থিক ছাড় বা কমিটমেন্ট না দেওয়া।

additional_requirements: Age At least 24 years   অভিজ্ঞতা:   সংশ্লিষ্ট কাজে ১ থেকে ২ বছরের অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন প্রার্থীরা অগ্রাধিকার পাবেন।  তবে কাজে দক্ষ, চটপটে ও শেখার আগ্রহ থাকলে নতুনদেরও (Freshers) আবেদন করার সুযোগ রয়েছে। প্রয়োজনীয় যোগ্যতা ও দক্ষতা পণ্যের দরদাম (Negotiation) ও বাজার বিশ্লেষণের ভালো দক্ষতা। কার্যকর যোগাযোগ দক্ষতা ও চমৎকার পেশাদার আচরণ। সততা, সময়ানুবর্তিতা এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানের গোপনীয়তা বজায় রাখার মানসিকতা। কম্পিউটার ও সাধারণ হিসাবনিকাশ পরিচালনায় প্রাথমিক দক্ষতা (MS Excel, Email ইত্যাদি)। কর্মদক্ষতা মূল্যায়নের মানদণ্ড (KPIs) প্রতিযোগিতামূলক মূল্যে সেরা মানের পণ্য সংগ্রহ। সঠিক ও নির্ভরযোগ্য সরবরাহকারী নির্বাচন। বিল, ভাউচার ও পণ্যের হিসাবের শতভাগ নির্ভুলতা। সময়মতো পণ্য সংগ্রহ ও সফল ডেলিভারি সম্পন্নকরণ। নির্ভুল ডেলিভারি এবং অভিযোগের হার শূন্যে নামিয়ে আনা। দায়িত্বশীলতা, সততা ও গোপনীয়তা রক্ষা।

job_description: Founded in 2000 on the belief that World Change Starts with Educated Children®, Room to Read develops children’s foundational literacy skills, as well as life-skills that promote gender equality in 29 countries. As a leading implementer, we nurture these essential skills in children by strengthening education systems – all while honoring the dignity of every child. Our Literacy Portfolio supports children in developing literacy skills and a love of reading by training and coaching educators, creating quality curriculum and children’s book content in local languages, and enriching learning spaces that enable children to become independent readers. Our Gender Equality Portfolio supports all adolescents, particularly girls, to develop life skills that promote gender equality with curriculum that focuses on collaboration, resilience, leadership, decision-making and critical thinking. Room to Read envisions a world free from illiteracy and gender inequality, where all children have room to read, learn and grow. Since 2009 in Bangladesh, Room to Read is implementing education support programs in historically low-income and remote communities in Natore, Cox’s Bazar, Dhaka, Moulvibazar, Narail, Jhalakathi, Jamalpur and Habiganj. Till 2026, we have supported the education of more than 2.79 million children in Primary and 3.1 million girls in Secondary schools in various capacities. We are proud to have worked with DPE, NCTB, DSHE and a2i on various scalable and systemic initiatives, the latest being a pilot with DPL in Moulvibazar, Narsingdi and Cox’s Bazar, and with NAPE in Mymensingh, including several phased interventions on national radio and TV complementing GoB quality education (SDG4) initiatives. LFs will co-facilitate instruction and library training with Literacy Program Officers/Government (GoB) Officials and will participate in sub-cluster training and conduct session/discuss about Literacy Portfolio activities which are where appropriate. They will also assist in the preparation of training materials, reports, and documentation. LF will be responsible for 20 GPS and reports to the Literacy Program Officer and is based on the assigned upazila within the districts Duties and responsibilities: Provide support to the teachers in understanding the Modified Co-implemented literacy program. Provide support in implementing the literacy program intervention across assigned schools following the new design (Modified Co-implemented LP model). সংস্থার ফাইন্যান্স অ্যান্ড অ্যাকাউন্টস টিমের জন্য ব্রাঞ্চ হিসাবরক্ষক নিয়োজিত হবেন। Job Responsibilities: সংস্থার আর্থিক ব্যবস্থাপনা নির্দেশিকা অনুসরণ করে হিসাব সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় দায়িত্ব পালন করা। সংস্থার নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী কার্যক্রম পরিপালন করা এবং সরকারি ও বেসরকারি প্রতিষ্ঠান এবং এমআরএ সংক্রান্ত আর্থিক বিষয়সমূহ আপডেট রাখা। হাজিরা ও মুভমেন্ট ও ছুটি সংক্রান্ত সংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা ও রেজিস্টার সংরক্ষণ করা। বার্ষিক কর্ম-পরিকল্পনা প্রণয়নে সহযোগিতা করা এবং সে অনুযায়ী বাজেট প্রস্তুত করা। অনুমোদিত বাজেট নিয়ন্ত্রণ ও ত্রৈমাসিক ভিত্তিতে বাজেট ভেরিয়েন্স রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করে কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। এলও ভিত্তিক প্রতিদিনের আদায়শিটের টাকা বুঝে নেওয়া, উক্ত টাকা ব্যাংকে জমা নিশ্চিত করা এবং সফটওয়্যারে পোস্টিং দেওয়া। ক্যাশ ও ব্যাংক সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা। বিল ও ভাউচার চেকিং, অনুমোদিত বিলের টাকা প্রদান, ভাউচার প্রস্তুত ও অনুমোদন এবং সমন্বয় সংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করে সফটওয়্যারে পোস্টিং দেওয়া। দৈনিক তথ্যশিট ও প্রাপ্তি-প্রদান শিট প্রিন্ট দিয়ে যথাযথ স্বাক্ষরসহ সংরক্ষণ করা। ক্যাশ বুক, জেনারেল লেজার, আয়-ব্যয় হিসাব, প্রাপ্তি-প্রদান হিসাব, রেওয়ামিল ও উদ্বৃত্তপত্র প্রস্তুত ও সংরক্ষণ করা। সদস্য ভর্তি ফরম ও ঋণ আবেদন ফরম যাচাই ও সংরক্ষণ করা। ঋণ বিতরণের পূর্বে ঋণ আবেদন ফরম সরেজমিনে যাচাই করা। ঋণ বিতরণ ও নগদে সঞ্চয় উত্তোলন/ফেরতের ক্ষেত্রে যাবতীয় ডকুমেন্টস চেক করে টাকা প্রদান করা। কর্মীদের বেতন-ভাতা সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন অফিস ভাড়ার চুক্তিপত্র নবায়ন কার্যক্রমে বিএমকে সহযোগিতা করা। সরকারি নিয়মানুযায়ি ভ্যাট ও ট্যাক্স সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা এবং সকল রেজিস্টার হালনাগাদ রাখা ও যথাযথভাবে সংরক্ষণ করা। পিএফ, গ্রাচুইটি, লিভ-পে ও স্টাফ ঋণ সংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রম সস্পাদন করা এবং হিসাব সংক্রান্ত রিপোর্ট যাচাই ও পর্যালোচনা করা। মাসিক এফআইএস ও এমআইএস রিপোর্ট মিলকরণ করা এবং যথাযথ স্বাক্ষরসহ সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক তহবিল চাহিদা প্রস্তুত করা, তহবিল গ্রহণ, প্রদান ও প্রাপ্তি স্বীকার নিশ্চিত করা। তহবিল সংক্রান্ত বিষয়ে জোনাল অফিস ও প্রয়োজনে অন্য অফিসের সাথে যোগাযোগ রক্ষা করা। নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী ক্রয়-বিক্রয় সম্পর্কিত কার্যক্রম এবং স্টোর ও স্থায়ী সম্পদ সম্পর্কিত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা এবং সম্পদের সংরক্ষণ করা। কর্মীর ছাড়পত্র সম্পর্কিত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা। দৈনন্দিন, সাপ্তাহিক, মাসিক, বার্ষিক আর্থিক প্রতিবেদনসহ কর্তৃপক্ষের চাহদানুযায়ী বিভিন্ন প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করা ও কর্তৃপক্ষকে তা প্রেরণ করা। অভ্যন্তরীণ নিরীক্ষা ও বহিঃনিরীক্ষা কার্যে সহযোগিতা করা। অ্যাকাউন্টস ও ফাইন্যান্স সংক্রান্ত বিভিন্ন মিটিং/ওয়ার্কশপে যোগদান করা। job_description: Job Context Eco-Social Development Organization (ESDO) started its journey in 1988 with a noble vision to stand in solidarity with the poor and marginalized. Being a people` centered organization, ESDO envisioned for a society which will be free from inequality and injustice, a society where no child will cry from hunger and no life will be ruined by poverty. Near about three decades of relentless efforts to make this happen, ESDO has embraced new grounds and opened up new horizons to help the disadvantaged and vulnerable people to bring meaningful and lasting changes in their lives. During this long span, ESDO has adapted with the changing situation and provided the most time-bound services especially for the poor and disadvantaged. A community focused and people centered approach has been adapted by ESDO while consideration was given to the national policy and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) as its guiding principle. ESDO is one of the most dynamic organizations expanding its development interventions across 422 upazilas under 56 districts of Bangladesh covering over 10 million poor and vulnerable people. ESDO is going to implement a UNICEF-supported project titled “Provide quality, inclusive skills development and Myanmar Curriculum STEM education for adolescent learners aged 15-18, and portable skills training for education volunteers in Cox`s Bazar” in Rohingya camps of Ukhia, Cox’s Bazar. The project aims to improve access to quality foundational literacy numeracy (FLN), trade skills, employability skills, leadership skills, entrepreneurship training,, STEM Education and portable skills opportunities for Rohingya adolescents and youth through multi-Purpose Centers (MPCs), Science & IT Labs, and SKILFO-based portable skills interventions. The Procurement Associate is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing every procurement activity under this project in accordance with UNICEF requirements, ESDO`s procurement policy, donor regulations, and the specific compliance commitments made during partnership approval. The position ensures the timely, transparent, cost-effective, and audit-defensible procurement of the goods, services, works, learning and teaching materials, trade course tools and consumables, laboratory equipment, EdTech devices, safeguarding and community awareness materials, and general office and facility supplies that programme delivery depends on. In a project of this scale, spread across multiple camps, multi-purpose centres, and laboratories, procurement discipline directly determines whether classes start on time, whether learners have the materials they need, and whether donor funds can be liquidated cleanly. The Procurement Associate will work under the direct supervision of the the Skills Development Technical Lead on procurement priorities aligned to programme delivery, and will coordinate closely with the Warehouse Associate, Finance Associate, HR and Admin Associate, and programme colleagues across trade, laboratory, and facility functions. S/he will also closely liaison with the ESDO Head Office procurement focal. Reporting to: Direct Reporting to Skills Development Technical Lead Job Responsibilities A. Procurement Planning, Cycle Management, and Timely Delivery Prepare and update project procurement plans in consultation with the Admin and Finance Manager, the Skills Development Technical Lead, and programme colleagues, aligned to the approved budget, activity calendar, and quarterly Direct Cash Transfer (DCT) cycles. Process procurement requests received from programme, warehouse, laboratory, and administration colleagues in a disciplined sequence, and maintain a procurement tracking system that gives management real-time visibility of every open, pending, and completed procurement. Anticipate delivery lead times and ensure procurement is initiated early enough that goods and services reach the field before the activities they support, so that no cohort session, laboratory practical, or field deployment is delayed for want of materials. Support procurement forecasting, market intelligence, and cost benchmarking so that annual and quarterly plans are realistic and defensible. B. Sourcing, Tendering, Vendor Management, and Contracting Conduct sourcing and tendering in strict compliance with ESDO`s procurement policy and UNICEF partnership requirements, applying the three-quote rule, no-splitting principle, and open, competitive process for procurements above the applicable thresholds. Prepare Requests for Quotation (RFQ), Requests for Proposal (RFP), bid documents, comparative statements, and evaluation records with accuracy and full documentation of the decision trail. Coordinate quotation collection, bid opening, technical and financial evaluation, and award decisions in a fair and transparent manner, and ensure the composition of any evaluation committee reflects the required segregation of duties. Maintain a vetted vendor database and vendor enlistment records, monitor vendor performance across quality, timeliness, and contractual compliance, and remove non-performing or non-compliant vendors from the database with documented reasons. Prepare purchase orders, contracts, and service agreements with clear specifications, delivery terms, penalty and safeguarding clauses, and payment conditions. C. Cross-Functional Coordination with Warehouse, Finance, and Programme Teams Coordinate with the Warehouse Associate on incoming goods, ensuring proper Goods Receipt Notes, inspection, quality verification, and documented handover before payment is processed. Coordinate with the Finance Associate on payment processing, vendor documentation, statutory deduction compliance, and reconciliation of procurement transactions in the accounting system. Coordinate with the Skills Development Technical Lead, Science and IT Labs Field Assistant, HR and Admin Associate, and Associate Construction Engineer on programme-driven specifications so that what is procured actually meets end-user needs and no last-minute substitutions compromise programme quality. Provide timely procurement information to programme colleagues so that implementation planning is informed by realistic sourcing and delivery timelines. D. Compliance, HACT, Audit Readiness, and Value for Money Ensure every procurement complies with UNICEF financial guidelines, PCA requirements, HACT rules, ESDO`s procurement policy, and the specific commitments made during partnership approval. Ensure value-for-money principles are applied consistently, balancing cost, quality, delivery timing, and lifecycle considerations, and document the value-for-money rationale in every award decision. Ensure procurement activities comply with statutory obligations of the Government of Bangladesh, including VAT, tax, and NGO Affairs Bureau requirements, in coordination with the Finance Associate. Support internal audits, UNICEF financial spot checks, programmatic spot checks, HACT assurance activities, and external or donor audits by providing accurate procurement documentation, decision trails, and explanations. E. Safeguarding, PSEA, Accountability, Anti-Fraud Obligations and Ethical Practices Ensure every vendor, sub-contractor, and service provider signs up to ESDO`s Code of Conduct, PSEA and Child Safeguarding standards, and anti-fraud undertaking before engagement, in line with the organizational PSEA Action Plan. Ensure procurement contracts and service agreements include clear clauses on prohibition of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA), definition of SEA, reporting obligations, and corrective action, in line with UN Implementing Partner Protocol requirements. Screen vendors and suppliers against exclusion, sanctions, and safeguarding lists as required, and escalate any suspicious pattern of behaviour or conflict-of-interest concern to the Admin and Finance Manager and Skills Development Technical Lead Ensure no gift, hospitality, favour, or personal benefit is accepted from vendors, suppliers, or service providers, and declare any potential conflict of interest immediately. Maintain strict confidentiality of procurement, vendor, and pricing information, and escalate any suspicion of fraud, collusion, price manipulation, or safeguarding concern to the Admin and Finance Manager and Skills Development Technical Lead immediately. Uphold the highest standards of Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA), Child Safeguarding (CSG), Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP), and anti-fraud behaviour in every procurement transaction and vendor interaction. F. Reporting, Documentation, and Records Management Maintain complete, well-indexed, and secure procurement files (physical and electronic) covering every stage of the procurement cycle from requisition to payment and delivery. Prepare monthly and quarterly procurement status reports, vendor performance summaries, and inputs to project reports, HACT assurance activities, and donor monitoring visits. Ensure procurement records reconcile with warehouse and financial records on a monthly basis. H. Other Responsibilities Participate in project procurement reviews, planning sessions, and coordination forums as required. Contribute to continuous improvement of procurement processes and systems within the project. Any other duties assigned by the Admin and Finance Manager in the interest of the project.

Maintain proper housekeeping and cleanliness of the QC laboratory. Ensure proper handling, labeling, storage, and disposal of laboratory chemicals and materials. job_description: Introduction:  Solidaridad (www.solidaridadnetwork.org) is a global network organization working to build sustainable, resource-efficient, and inclusive supply chains. Solidaridad fosters smallholder and worker empowerment by co-creating scalable, economically viable solutions in agricultural and industrial landscapes alongside governments, businesses, and local communities. In coastal southwest Bangladesh, Solidaridad is implementing the extension phase of the ‘Sustainable Agriculture, Food Security and Livelihoods for Integrated Water Resources Management (SAFAL for IWRM)’ project. Having successfully revitalized 92 micro-watersheds, improving agricultural productivity and livelihoods for over 91,000 farming households, the project now focuses on institutionalizing watershed-based governance to ensure equitable water distribution, resource efficiency, and climate resilience. To bridge community-led water management with private sector-led supply chains and advanced agricultural innovations, the project aims to establish a bankable, commercial water-climate-agriculture nexus approach that transitions micro-watersheds into self-sustaining, commercially viable Agri-Business Hubs. Solidaridad Network Asia is seeking Programme Officers – Ecosystem Regeneration to provide technical and operational leadership for the field-level implementation of the Ecosystem Regeneration component. Under the strategic guidance of the Manager – Ecosystem Regeneration, the Programme Officer will support and guide Field Extension Officers in strengthening farmers’ capacities on ecosystem regeneration practices, developing farmer entrepreneurs within the supply chain, and promoting the adoption of digital advisory systems. The position will also contribute to systematic documentation of field experiences, good practices, lessons learned, and emerging innovations to support programme learning and scale-up. job_description: Extended Community Climate Change Project- Drought (ECCCP-Drought) Background of the project Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF), an apex development organization focusing on holistic and integrated approaches, was established by the Government of Bangladesh in May 1990 for sustainable poverty reduction through employment generation. PKSF has been implementing projects and programs in diversified sectors including sustainable enterprise, training and education, agriculture, climate change and disaster and so on. PKSF works with more than 15 million households through its 200 partner organizations. Many development partners, such as the World Bank, DFID, EU, ADB, IFAD, GIZ, GCF, and Adaptation Fund (AF) are working with PKSF. Please visit http://www.pksf.org.bd for details.PKSF has been accredited to the Green Climate Fund (GCF), the only dedicated and largest climate change finance window, established under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), in 2013. The GCF has approved the ECCCP-Drought project in the fact that Bangladesh faces an unpredictable drought hazard due to inadequate and uneven rainfall that affects the timing of onset and end of the monsoon season. The northwestern Barind region/districts of Bangladesh suffer the most from droughts. Climate change is changing the nature of droughts in Barind by increasing temperature and variations in precipitation. During droughts, almost all natural surface water sources evaporate, leaving none for drinking, sanitation or agriculture. CCDB is currently seeking a Project Manager for its project, “Integrated Climate-Resilient Livelihood Program for Costal Bangladesh (ICRL-BD)” Project. To provide overall leadership, technical and operational management, coordination, quality assurance and accountability for implementation of the ICRL-BD project, ensuring achievement of outcomes and outputs through locally led adaptation, inclusive governance, climate-resilient livelihood development, anticipatory action, MEAL and effective stakeholder engagement. Project Summary:   The ICRL-BD project will strengthen the resilience and livelihood security of climate affected coastal communities in selected climate-vulnerable villages of Barguna Sadar Upazila. The project addresses climate risks including cyclones, tidal surges, salinity intrusion, flooding, river erosion and sea-level rise through community-driven climate-resilient livelihoods, anticipatory action, inclusive governance and strengthened adaptive capacity. Priority will be given to women, small-scale farmers, fishers, landless households, youth, persons with disabilities and people at risk of displacement. Job Summary: Lead the overall planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring and adaptive management of the project in accordance with the approved proposal, workplan, budget and CCDB policies. Ensure delivery against the three project outcomes and associated outputs, including resilient livelihoods, disaster preparedness and climate-resilient WASH/DRR, and inclusive climate governance and finance. Guide field staff and community structures to apply Locally Led Adaptation (LLA), Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), safeguarding and accountability principles. Ensure effective implementation of community-based early warning, anticipatory action, climate-resilient WASH and DRR interventions, and strengthen community participation in local adaptation planning and climate finance processes. Maintain effective coordination with Union Parishad, local government institutions, service providers, community organizations, People’s Organizations and other relevant stakeholders. Ensure timely documentation, reporting, learning and evidence generation, including sex-, age- and disability-disaggregated results. Responsibilities of the Position : Lead project planning, budgeting, scheduling and procurement in line with the approved project design. Translate project outcomes, outputs and indicators into field-level plans, targets and staff responsibilities. Coordinate and supervise overall project implementation to ensure quality, timeliness and achievement of results. Monitor progress, budget utilization, risks and implementation gaps, ensuring timely corrective and adaptive actions. Ensure effective coordination among project staff, communities, partners and relevant stakeholders. Ensure compliance with donor requirements, CCDB policies, safeguarding and quality standards. job_description: Nari Maitree (NM), a well-established women-led NGO with 43 years of experience in Bangladesh, dedicated to empowering women, children, and marginalized communities through human rights, gender equality, disaster resilience, and health initiatives. As a key consortium partner of IRC in the DFAT-funded program "Protection-Centred and Locally Driven Response for Rohingya Refugees in Cox’s Bazar," Nari Maitree leads on Gender Equality and Gender-Diverse Inclusion within the Consortium’s GEDSI (Gender Equality, Diversity, Disability and Social Inclusion) and Intersectionality Community of Practice, which it co-leads with the Centre for Disability in Development (CDD), the lead on Disability Inclusion. Nari Maitree also delivers GBV prevention and response activities, within the technical coherence of the Protection Community of Practice led by IRC. Duty Station: Ukhiya, Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh (with frequent field visits to Rohingya camps and host communities) Reports To: Director – Program (line management) and technical collaborations with the Safeguarding Coordinator (IRC) and the Consortium Program Coordinator    Grade/Level: Senior Management / Technical Lead Level Type of Contract: Fixed-Term (Project Duration) Position Summary Nari Maitree is seeking an experienced, highly qualified Gender Expert to provide strategic and technical leadership to ensure that gender equality, diversity, and social inclusion are systematically integrated into technical design, harmonization, and quality assurance initiatives across the seven Consortium organisations (IRC and the six Bangladeshi partners: Nari Maitree, BTS, CDD, FIVDB, CNRS and NGO Forum for Public Health). The Gender Expert will co-lead the consortium’s GEDSI and Intersectionality Community of Practice (CoP), leading technical approaches on gender equality and gender-diverse inclusion, and contributing gender and GBV technical expertise to the Protection CoP led by IRC. The position represents Nari Maitree in the Project Management Unit (PMU) as the Gender Advisor, ensuring gender-responsive and intersectional principles are embedded across all sector activities (Protection, Health, WASH, Education, Livelihoods). The post holder is Nari Maitree’s technical focal point for applying the IRC GEDI Marker at inception, annually and at project end, as set out in the Consortium GEDSI Strategy. GEDSI is applied as an intersectional mandate spanning gender, disability, age, diversity and other dimensions of exclusion, and is not limited to gender and SOGIESC. Within that mandate the Gender Expert leads on gender equality and gender-diverse inclusion and works jointly with CDD, which leads on disability inclusion, so that intersecting barriers are addressed across every Consortium sector. Technical Leadership & Co-Chairing the GEDSI CoP Co-Lead the GEDSI & Intersectionality CoP:  Co-facilitate the quarterly Consortium CoP on GEDSI, leading specifically on  Gender and Gender Diversity , jointly with CDD, which leads the CoP on Disability Inclusion. Develop and maintain the CoP Terms of Reference and agreed annual action plan, and escalate critical technical issues to the PMU. Technical Guidance & Standards:  Establish and harmonize technical standards, toolkits, and SOPs for gender mainstreaming and gender-diverse inclusion across the seven Consortium organisations, and contribute gender expertise to GBV technical standards developed through the Protection CoP led by IRC. Intersectional Analysis:  Lead regular gender and intersectionality assessments to identify unique barriers faced by women, girls, and gender-diverse individuals, including hijra, kothi, transgender people and individuals with diverse SOGIESC, in camp and host community settings. Use the findings to inform Consortium programme design, adaptation and risk mitigation, and report them to the PMU. GEDSI-responsive program design and adaptation : Provide technical advice to consortium partners to integrate findings from gender, disability, diversity and intersectionality analysis into program design, implementation, adaptation and risk mitigation, including measures to address barriers to meaningful participation and equitable access to services. Technical Inter-Agency Coordination:  Represent Nari Maitree in the GiHA,  Gender Diverse Population (GDP) Working Group  under the Protection Sector, chaired by Bandhu Social Welfare Society, and collaborate with other specialised actors, women-led organisations and Organisations of Persons with Disabilities (OPDs) to validate findings, co-design activities and support advocacy. Capacity Strengthening & Partner Support Technical Mentorship:  Provide ongoing technical advice, coaching, and capacity building to field-based implementing teams across all consortium partner organizations. Training & Tool Adaptation:  Design and facilitate specialized training modules on gender equality, Do No Harm principles, GBV risk mitigation, and GEDSI and SOGIESC sensitisation for all project staff and community volunteers across all Consortium partner organisations, as committed in the Consortium GEDSI Strategy. Safe & Inclusive Programming:  Assist consortium members in auditing field activities to ensure services (health, WASH, protection, education, livelihoods) are safe, accessible, and responsive to gender-specific needs. Develop result-oriented action plans and recommendations to address the accessibility, participation, safety and inclusion risks identified, and follow up on their implementation with partners. Program Quality Assurance & Monitoring (MEL) GEDSI Integration in MEL:  Collaborate with the MEL CoP (IRC & NGO Forum) to ensure project indicators, monitoring tools, and baseline/endline evaluations capture sex, age, disability and diversity disaggregated data and qualitative gender outcomes, and that mixed methods are used to understand not only what is changing, but for whom and why. Support partners to use these findings to identify differential outcomes, levels of participation and unintended impacts across intersecting groups, and to adapt programming accordingly. GEDI Marker Application:  Serve as Nari Maitree’s technical focal point for the IRC GEDI Marker, the participatory tool for assessing Safe, Inclusive and Transformative (SIT) Programming against its eight indicators. Support the structured team exercise at inception to set a baseline, annually to assess progress, and at project end; translate scores into agreed improvement actions; and report results to the PMU and the CoP. Field Monitoring:  Conduct periodic field monitoring visits to camps and host communities to assess the quality and inclusivity of gender-responsive programming, providing actionable recommendations to the PMU. Inclusive Client Responsiveness:  Support Consortium partners to apply the IRC Inclusive Client Responsiveness Toolbox so that feedback channels are accessible to women, girls, young children, persons with disabilities and gender-diverse individuals, and support analysis of feedback disaggregated by sex and vulnerability, including closing the feedback loop with communities. Learning & Documentation:  Document best practices, lessons learned, and policy briefs regarding gender equality and gender-diverse inclusion to feed into consortium learning loops and DFAT reporting. PMU Support & Stakeholder Engagement Technical Inputs for Reporting:  Provide high-quality technical inputs, gender analyses, and progress updates for consolidated donor reports submitted to IRC and DFAT. Sector Representation:  Represent Nari Maitree`s technical gender domain in relevant sub-sectors (GBV Sub-Sector, Protection Sector, Gender in Humanitarian Action Working Group) under the UN-led Refugee Coordination Platform (RCP). Safeguarding Interface (advisory):  Contribute gender and GBV risk analysis to safeguarding and PSEA risk assessments and mitigation planning. Overall safeguarding and PSEA oversight rests with IRC through the Safeguarding & PSEAH Specialist, the IRC Bangladesh Ethics and Compliance Senior Coordinator and the IRC HQ Ethics and Compliance Unit. Any safeguarding, PSEA or fraud concern must be referred immediately through IRC’s established safeguarding, PSEA and anti-fraud reporting channels, which apply to all Consortium personnel. This is the mandatory reporting duty that applies to every member of personnel. Coordinate and support internal, external, customer, and regulatory fire/safety audits and ensure timely closure of identified findings. Fire Protection & Life Safety Systems Ensure proper operation, inspection, testing, maintenance, and readiness of fire protection and life safety systems, including: o	Fire alarm and detection systems o	Fire sprinkler systems o	Standpipe and hydrant systems o	Fire pumps and related equipment o	Fire extinguishers and hose reels o	Emergency lighting and exit signage o	Passive fire protection systems o	Other firefighting and emergency response equipment Conduct regular inspections of fire protection and life safety equipment and maintain accurate inspection, testing, and maintenance records. Ensure fire exits, escape routes, stairways, emergency doors, and other means of egress remain accessible, unobstructed, and properly maintained. Conduct regular fire drills and evaluate emergency evacuation performance, identifying areas for improvement. Technical Design & Project Management Prepare, review, and manage technical designs, BOQs, specifications, and cost estimates for fire protection and life safety systems, including: o	Fire sprinkler systems o	Standpipe and hydrant systems o	Fire alarm systems o	Fire pump systems o	Passive fire protection systems Perform and/or review hydraulic calculations, battery calculations, voltage-drop calculations, and conduit calculations. Conduct site surveys, inspections, and technical assessments for fire safety projects. Plan, coordinate, monitor, and manage fire protection and safety projects from design through installation, testing, commissioning, and handover. Review contractors’ work to ensure compliance with approved designs, project specifications, and applicable fire safety standards. Ensure proper testing and commissioning of fire protection and life safety systems. Team Leadership & Coordination Lead and supervise Fire & Safety Officers, Fire Fighters, and other safety personnel. Prepare duty rosters and ensure adequate manpower coverage across all shifts. Assess team performance, identify competency gaps, and arrange appropriate training and development programs. Develop team capabilities and promote a strong fire safety culture throughout the organization. Ensure effective coordination and communication among Fire & Safety, HR/Admin, Engineering, Production, Maintenance, and other relevant departments. Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders on fire safety-related matters. Fire Risk Assessment & Emergency Preparedness Conduct regular factory fire and safety inspections to identify hazards, unsafe conditions, and potential fire risks. Recommend and implement appropriate corrective and preventive measures to mitigate identified risks. Monitor the effectiveness of fire prevention and emergency preparedness programs. Ensure appropriate emergency response procedures are established, communicated, and periodically reviewed. Technical Skills & Other Responsibilities Demonstrate proficiency in AutoCAD, Photoshop, and 2D/3D design tools relevant to fire safety projects. Apply strong practical knowledge of fire detection, fire protection, fire safety planning, and relevant engineering principles. Manage multiple projects and priorities effectively while working under pressure and meeting deadlines. Perform any other fire safety-related duties and responsibilities assigned by management.

Organizational Setting The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) contributes to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda through the FAO Strategic Framework by supporting the transformation to MORE efficient, inclusive, resilient and sustainable agrifood systems, for better production, better nutrition, a better environment and a better life, leaving no one behind. FAO is a specialized agency of the UN that leads international efforts to defeat hunger. FAO's goal is to achieve food security for all and ensure that people have regular access to enough high-quality food to lead active, healthy lives. With 195 Members (194 countries and the European Union), FAO works in over 130 countries worldwide. FAO Country Offices, working under overall corporate guidance and in line with the Strategic Framework, offer policy advice and support to countries in the mandated areas of FAO, facilitated through partnerships, resources and an active country programme to provide technical assistance, develop capacities and deliver core services while fully observing international standards of accountability to establish leadership and strengthen impact at the country level. The offices deliver on the programmatic priorities of each country as agreed in their respective Country Programming Frameworks (CPFs) aligned to the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) and ensure effective and efficient operations with adequate human and financial resources. Specifically, FAO Country Offices: advocate, inform and support policies and investments in the areas of FAO’s mandate; provide technical assistance and deliver core services; assist and catalyse partnership and resource mobilization activities to support agrifood systems transformation; position FAO as the specialized/authoritative technical agency in food and agriculture and agrifood systems transformation; and ensure risk-smart and accountable operations and management. job_description: Context: Quality Hospitality Limited  invites applications from highly accomplished hospitality leaders for the position of  General Manager  of  Q-HOTEL Dhaka , an upcoming  5-star luxury property. This is a pivotal leadership role with full accountability for the successful pre-opening and subsequent ongoing operations of the hotel. The  General Manager will serve as the primary strategic business leader of the property, responsible for delivering exceptional guest experiences, strong financial performance, high employee engagement, and a solid return on investment to ownership. The role requires a proven track record in full-service hotel leadership, preferably with pre-opening experience, and a strong background in Food & Beverage. Job Responsibilities Overall Leadership & Strategic Direction Direct the entire operations of the hotel by developing and implementing strategies and services that meet or exceed the needs of owners, guests, and employees. Function as the primary strategic business leader of the property with full responsibility for guest and employee satisfaction, human resources, financial performance, sales and revenue generation, and delivering a return on investment to ownership. Verify the implementation of service strategies and initiatives with the objective of meeting or exceeding guest expectations, increasing profit, and growing market share. Hold the property leadership team accountable for strategy execution while guiding their individual professional development. Ensure sales engines are fully leveraged and initiate independent, proactive sales activities when appropriate to generate demand. Build owner loyalty through proactive communication, clear expectation setting, and consistent delivery of solid business results. Actively engage with the local community and build strong relationships with local officials, businesses, and customers. Pre-Opening Responsibilities Project Coordination Maintain constant liaison with the Technical Services Team and Owning Company regarding the status of all site activities. Attend all project meetings and prepare accurate minutes/notes. Assist the Technical Services Team and Owning Company with punch lists and the formal handover process. Participate in New Hotel Pre-Opening Meetings with relevant agenda items and constructive input. Owner Relations Provide regular updates to ownership on all pre-opening activities. Obtain ownership approval for any positions or decisions that require their authorization. Act as the primary liaison between Quality Hospitality Limited (QHL) and Q-HOTEL Dhaka (QHD). Finance (Pre-Opening) Assist in the preparation of the Pre-Opening Budget. Submit monthly Pre-Opening Reports including updated budget expense tracking. Reforecast Pre-Opening Budget figures based on project timeline and immediately advise Quality Hospitality Limited if the budget is likely to be exceeded. Submit the full Business Plan according to the agreed schedule based on the projected Soft Opening Date. Operations (Pre-Opening) Submit monthly Pre-Opening Reports covering updated activities and critical path items. Prepare detailed Operating Supplies and Equipment (OS&E) lists for costing and owner approval. Obtain Quality Hospitality Limited approval for all key items including uniforms, restaurant and facility names, logos, tabletops, Executive Committee positions, room types, and rate matrix. Ensure full awareness of Quality Group Standard Operating Procedures and how they will affect hotel operations. Maintain complete knowledge of local employment laws and human resources requirements. Develop Executive Committee and staff contracts in accordance with Quality Hospitality Limited guidelines. Ensure all Standard Operating Procedure manuals are completed at least 12 weeks prior to Soft Opening and submitted for Owner’s approval. Guarantee that every aspect of the hotel is fully prepared for Soft Opening, including successful completion of test dining and test stays. Post-Opening Strategic & Operational Leadership Develop and implement business strategies for the hotel that are fully aligned with Quality Hospitality Limited’s overall mission, vision, values, and strategies. Monitor progress regularly and adjust strategies as required. Ensure continuous alignment of hotel operations with owners’ and owning company objectives by serving as the key liaison for owner relations. Develop the annual business plan and capital budget in conjunction with the Financial Controller and Department Heads, and assist in obtaining owner approval. Collaborate with other entities within the Quality Group to leverage resources, purchases, revenues, and training opportunities. Achieve the hotel’s profit, customer service, and revenue goals by directing overall hotel operations. Maximize revenue by developing and implementing comprehensive sales and marketing plans. Seek opportunities to publicize the hotel through a structured public relations strategy and by building a strong local network. Work with the Executive Team to continuously improve hotel operations by evaluating guest services and responding to market opportunities. Analyze business results regularly and take decisive action to improve performance. Continuously monitor forward projections and communicate any variances promptly to Quality Hospitality Limited. Leverage system-wide expertise and resources to incorporate best practices and deliver services cost-effectively. Ensure the hotel strictly adheres to all standards of operations as per Quality Hospitality Limited guidelines. Revenue Management Monitor hotel operations and sales performance against budget. Review reports and financial statements to assess performance against budget. Coach and support the Operations Team to effectively manage occupancy, average rate, wages, and controllable expenses. Review the Wage Progress Report, compare budgeted wages to actual, and hold direct reports accountable for results. Work closely with the Sales Team to drive and surpass hotel revenues across all areas of the operation. Collaborate with the Revenue Management Team to develop effective pricing strategies that balance seasonality, customer segments, property objectives, and guest satisfaction. Establish a revenue strategy that supports the hotel’s positioning in the local market; ensure robust demand forecasting and sound revenue practices are in place to maximize yield. Identify opportunities to grow occupancy, RevPAR, and market share by continuously researching competitor strategies. Financial Management & Accounting Oversight Ensure all financial aspects of operations are tightly controlled with focus on receipts and disbursements. Oversee the Finance Team in the timely preparation of financial reports as required by the Owning Company. Work cooperatively with the Executive Committee to maintain high-level operational and financial control. Ensure all work is accurate, timely, and fully compliant with the hotel’s standard accounting practices and the Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry. Provide guidance through accurate financial analysis and direction. Assure compliance with internal controls and check charts. Investigate and resolve any problems arising in the reporting of hotel operations. Perform audits to verify that systems are working accurately. Analyze variances to budget in operating statements and make appropriate recommendations. Ensure monthly cost and expense audits are carried out. Identify operational inefficiencies and propose solutions to the Owning Company. Authorize accounting-related documents according to Owning Company policies. Optimize cash flow in accordance with established policies. Ensure compliance with all applicable government laws, rules, and regulations, including timely preparation and filing of tax and license returns. Oversee collection of accounts receivable. Maintain accurate files on all contractual obligations of the hotel. Direct the preparation of any information required by Owners. Ensure compliance with daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting requirements. Ensure monthly and quarterly balance sheet reconciliations are completed. Direct the preparation of check charts, credit reports, month-end reports, and monthly P&L statements. Assist all departments in budget preparation. Ensure preparation of accurate monthly financial statements. Maintain an up-to-date capital improvement register. Prepare the Annual Business Plan, Budget Forecasting, and Costing. Leadership of Operations & Department Teams Champion the hotel’s service vision for product and service delivery and ensure full alignment across the leadership team. Develop systems that enable employees to understand and act on guest satisfaction results. Communicate clear and consistent messages regarding departmental goals to drive desired results. Guest Experience Management Create an environment of 100% guest satisfaction by ensuring employees receive the training and resources needed to deliver superior service and teamwork. Communicate and reinforce the vision for customer service to all managers, supervisors, and employees. Foster genuine hospitality and teamwork among the entire team. Ensure all minimum requirements of the Guest Satisfaction Guarantee are in place and fully understood. Develop customer feedback avenues and focus the management team on identifying trends and implementing solutions. Provide employees with the tools, training, and environment required to deliver outstanding service. Personally respond to and manage guest problems and complaints. Remain highly visible and regularly interface with guests to obtain direct feedback on product quality, service levels, and overall satisfaction. Human Resources Leadership Ensure all employees are treated fairly and equitably. Ensure regular, ongoing communication takes place in Operations (pre-shift briefings, staff meetings, etc.). Foster employee commitment to excellent service, participate in daily stand-up meetings, and model desired service behaviors. Incorporate guest satisfaction into staff/operations meetings with emphasis on continuous improvement. Set clear goals and expectations for direct reports through the performance review process and hold staff accountable. Solicit employee feedback, maintain an open-door policy, and review employee satisfaction results to address concerns. Ensure property policies are administered fairly and consistently, and that disciplinary procedures follow Standard and Local Operating Procedures. Support the Peer Review Process. Conduct annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures. Champion change, ensure Owning Company business initiatives are implemented, and communicate follow-up actions to the team. Standards, Compliance & Quality Assurance Verify full property compliance with legal, safety, operations, labor, and service standards. Conduct both routine and short-notice quality assurance audits with specific departments. Hold employees accountable for performing regular audits. Conduct detailed walk-throughs to ensure the building, public areas, kitchen, and grounds are well-maintained, safe, and meet or exceed guest expectations.

job_description: Bangladesh Labour Foundation (BLF) is a leading national organization working to promote and protect the rights of workers across both formal and informal sectors. Preferred Job Description / Responsibilities: Project Planning, Implementation & Operational Management Lead the operational delivery and activity synchronization of the 6 core project outcome areas: Living Wage & Wage Governance, Labour Law Reform & Inspection, Just Transition & Social Protection, OSH & SGBVH Prevention, Freedom of Association & Collective Bargaining, and HREDD & Supply Chain Accountability. Provide operational reports and technical support to the Project Steering Committee (PSC) and the half-yearly Project Advisory Committee (PAC).  Foster day-to-day institutional alignment, communication, and synergy among consortium partners (BLF, BILS, Awaj Foundation), ensuring seamless division of labour between policy advocacy, research, and grassroots mobilization.  Multi-Stakeholder Engagement, Social Dialogue & Advocacy Facilitate and coordinate bipartite and tripartite-plus policy dialogues, consultations, and lobby meetings involving the Ministry of Labour and Employment (MoLE), Department of Inspection for Factories and Establishments (DIFE), Department of Labour (DoL), National Wage Board, and National Skills Development Authority (NSDA). job_description: About Beauty Booth Beauty Booth is a growing beauty and lifestyle brand focused on delivering quality beauty products and an engaging customer experience through both online and offline channels. We are looking for a  results-driven Digital Marketing & E-commerce Growth Person  who can take ownership of our digital growth, paid advertising, customer acquisition, e-commerce performance, and retention initiatives. The ideal candidate should be highly analytical, commercially minded, and experienced in turning digital marketing activities into measurable  sales, revenue, customer acquisition, and profitability . Responsibilities Develop and execute digital marketing strategies to achieve sales, customer acquisition, conversion, and revenue growth objectives. Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other relevant digital channels. Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, bidding strategies, creative testing, and performance optimization to improve ROAS and customer acquisition efficiency. Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns for seasonal promotions, product launches, sales events, brand campaigns, BOGO, combo offers, and other promotional activities. Analyze marketing and ecommerce performance data, including sales, orders, AOV, conversion rate, CAC, ROAS, customer acquisition, and retention metrics, to identify opportunities and performance gaps. Monitor and evaluate performance at campaign, audience, creative, product, category, and customer-segment levels and implement data-driven optimization strategies. Manage and improve digital marketing tracking and attribution through GA4, Google Ads, Meta, Google Search Console, UTM tracking, and reporting platforms. Develop customer segmentation and CRM strategies based on customer purchase behavior, lifecycle stage, engagement, and transaction history. Identify opportunities for customer retention, reactivation, cross-selling, upselling, and personalized promotional offers using customer and sales data. Work closely with the Creative and Content team to develop campaign concepts, creative briefs, promotional messaging, UGC requirements, and performance-focused content. Coordinate with Merchandising, Supply Chain, Customer Support, Sales, and Technology teams to align marketing activities with product availability, inventory, customer service capacity, and business objectives. Analyze product and category performance to identify opportunities for promotions, bundles, clearance, BOGO, free gifts, and other sales-driving initiatives. Support the development and implementation of ecommerce and CRM features that improve customer experience, product discovery, personalization, and conversion. Conduct market, competitor, customer, and industry research to identify new marketing channels, growth opportunities, and emerging ecommerce trends. Prepare and present marketing performance reports, business insights, forecasts, and actionable recommendations to management. Develop and maintain marketing processes, campaign workflows, reporting structures, and SOPs to improve operational efficiency and scalability. Continuously test and improve marketing strategies, campaigns, creatives, offers, and customer journeys to drive sustainable ecommerce growth and profitability.

job_description: Job Description The Medical Officer – Staff Clinic & Vaccination Centre is responsible for providing comprehensive primary healthcare services to hospital employees, managing staff clinic activities, assessing employee fitness and medical leave requirements, supporting occupational health programs, and overseeing vaccination services. The position ensures that medical leave, fitness-for-duty, and work-restriction recommendations are based on appropriate clinical assessment, objective medical evidence, hospital policy, and applicable medical guidelines. Duties & Responsibilities 1. Staff Clinical Services Provide clinical consultation, examination, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up for hospital employees presenting with illness, injury, or other medical conditions. Assess employees who present with illness or medical conditions requiring absence from duty. Review the employee’s clinical history, presenting symptoms, physical findings, relevant investigation reports, and prescribed medications before recommending medical leave. Assess whether an employee is medically unfit to perform his/her assigned duties due to illness, injury, or other medical conditions. Provide appropriate treatment, health advice, and follow-up care within the scope of professional competence. Refer employees to appropriate specialists, hospitals, diagnostic centres, or other healthcare facilities when further assessment or treatment is required. Provide immediate first aid, emergency assessment, stabilization, and referral for workplace medical emergencies. 2. Medical Leave & Sick Leave Assessment Issue appropriate  medical certificates and sick leave recommendations  in accordance with hospital policy, applicable medical guidelines, and professional standards. Determine the appropriate duration of sick leave based on the employee’s clinical condition, treatment requirements, functional limitations, and expected recovery period. Where an employee submits a prescription, medical certificate, investigation report, or other medical document issued by another doctor/hospital, review the submitted documentation and, where appropriate, clinically assess the employee before endorsing or recommending sick leave. Avoid approving or recommending sick leave solely on the basis of a prescription or external medical document without appropriate clinical assessment, particularly where the proposed duration of leave is significant, the medical condition is unclear, or functional capacity requires clarification. Verify and assess relevant medical information objectively while respecting the confidentiality and professional integrity of the treating physician and employee. Conduct follow-up or reassessment where  extended sick leave, recurrent illness, prolonged absence, or continued functional limitation  is involved. Reassess employees when clinically appropriate before recommending continuation of prolonged medical leave. Ensure that sick leave recommendations are based on  clinical necessity, objective medical assessment, and functional capacity , rather than personal preference, discrimination, or undue influence. 3. Recommend  modified duties, restricted duties, temporary work restrictions, or phased return to work  where medically appropriate. Clearly communicate relevant work restrictions while maintaining appropriate medical confidentiality. Recommend further medical evaluation or specialist assessment where fitness for duty cannot be determined adequately at the Staff Clinic. job_description: Context: পিকান (PECAN: Participatory Engagement for City Communities Against NCD Risk in Bangladesh and Nepal) ডায়াবেটিক এসোসিয়েশন অব বাংলাদেশ সেন্টার ফর হেলথ রিসার্চ এন্ড ইমপ্লিমেন্টেশন (বাডাস-সিএইচআরআই), নেপালের হার্ড ইন্টারন্যাশনাল ও যুক্তরাজ্যের ইউনিভার্সিটি কলেজ লন্ডন ইনস্টিটিউট ফর গ্লোবাল হেলথ-এর একটি যৌথ গবেষণা প্রকল্প। পিকান প্রকল্পের "সহকারী ফিজিক্যাল ট্রেইনার" পদের জন্য ২ জন (দুইজন) নারী প্রশিক্ষক প্রয়োজন। বর্তমান গবেষণার লক্ষ্য হচ্ছে ডায়াবেটিস, উচ্চ রক্তচাপ এবং স্থূলতাসহ অসংক্রামক রোগ (এনসিডি) প্রতিরোধ ও নিয়ন্ত্রণের জন্য ফরিদপুর শহরে কমিউনিটিভিত্তিক শারীরিক কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন করা, যেখানে অংশগ্রহণকারী নারীদের নিজস্ব সিদ্ধান্ত ও পরিচালনার উপর গুরুত্ব দেওয়া হবে। চাকুরীর ধরণ:  পূর্ণকালীন অথবা খণ্ডকালীন চুক্তির ধরণ ও সময়সীমা : সাময়িকভাবে ১২-১৪ মাস চুক্তিভিত্তিক নিয়োগ দেওয়া হবে। চাকুরীর মেয়াদ বৃদ্ধি নির্ভর করবে নতুন ফান্ড প্রাপ্তি, প্রকল্পের মেয়াদ বৃদ্ধি এবং ট্রেইনারের দক্ষতা ও সফলতার উপর। কর্মস্থল:  ফিল্ডে এবং অফিসে দায়িত্বসমূহ: ফিজিক্যাল ট্রেইনারকে শরীরচর্চা সেশন পরিকল্পনা ও পরিচালনায় সহযোগিতা করা। নিয়মিত প্রশিক্ষণের সময় ফিজিক্যাল ট্রেইনারের সাথে যৌথভাবে সেশন পরিচালনা করা এবং প্রস্তুত হলে এককভাবে সেশন পরিচালনা করা। অংশগ্রহণকারীদের নিবন্ধন এবং প্রস্তুতি যাচাই সম্পন্ন করা। প্রতিটি সেশনে অংশগ্রহণকারীদের নিরাপত্তা পর্যবেক্ষণ করা এবং প্রয়োজনে প্রাথমিক চিকিৎসা প্রদান করা। স্বশরীরে ও অনলাইনে শরীরচর্চার ক্লাসে অংশগ্রহণের জন্য নারীদের উৎসাহিত করা। কমিউনিটি সচেতনতামূলক কার্যক্রমে অংশগ্রহণ করা, যেমন হোম ভিজিট ও লিফলেট বিতরণ। উপযুক্ত ভেন্যু নির্ধারণে সহযোগিতা করা এবং ব্যবহারের পূর্বে সম্ভাব্য ঝুঁকি পরীক্ষা করা। ফিজিক্যাল ট্রেইনারকে পিয়ার ভলান্টিয়ার প্রশিক্ষণ ও তত্ত্বাবধানে সহযোগিতা করা। সোশ্যাল মিডিয়ায় (যেমন ফেসবুক, ইউটিউব) দলের কার্যক্রম প্রচার করা। যাবতীয় কাজের রেকর্ড (উপস্থিতি, সেশন) সংরক্ষণ ও প্রতিবেদন তৈরি করতে সহায়তা করা।

Islamic Relief Worldwide (IRW) - founded in 1984 and based in Birmingham, UK - is an independent humanitarian and development organization. It supports the world’s most vulnerable people in their fight against poverty & sufferings regardless of race, political affiliation, gender, or belief, and without expecting anything in return. It is a signatory to the Code of Conduct for the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. 
IRW has a presence in 45 countries across the globe. Some funds of the organization come from individual donations and others from institutional donors such as the DFID, EU, SIDA, CIDA/IDRF, Forum Syd, WFP, UNDP, and ECHO.
Islamic Relief(IR) started working in Bangladesh in 1991 in order to help the distressed survivors of the devastating cyclone by providing emergency relief and supporting communities to rebuild in the wake of that cyclone. Initially, it focused on emergency relief & disaster preparedness activities. Later on, it expanded its programs on both humanitarian and development challenges. Now it works in an integrated manner combining emergency humanitarian assistance, short-term work opportunity, shelter support, awareness & training on different DRR, climate change, development, health & hygiene and social issues, cash grant, IGA means, health & nutrition, safe water & sanitation, education, advocacy and linkage with different service providers. As a registered charity, IR is open and transparent; it continually assesses its work and operational methods to improve impact and effectiveness. 
Islamic Relief values and commitment to safeguarding: IRB is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behavior at work including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity, and financial misconduct; and committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults, and beneficiaries with whom IRB engages. IRB expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We place a high priority on ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our values are recruited to work for us. All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records checks. IRW also participates in the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme.

Quasem Foundation is an organization dedicated to improving the lives of the impoverished people of Northern Bangladesh-- one of the most climate-vulnerable areas of the country. Bangladesh’s flat topography along with its dense population make it highly sensitive to climate change. This threat is experienced extremely by the drought and flood-prone Northern region. Quasem Foundation extends its charity where it is most needed and gives hope where it is most lacking.

করছে। নতুন কর্মএলাকা সম্প্রসারণের জন্য সংস্থার কর্মএলাকায় গ্রামীণ জনগোষ্টির সাথে কাজ করতে আগ্রহী যোগ্য, সৎ, কর্মঠ ও অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন বাংলাদেশী নাগরিকদের নিকট থেকে জরুরী ভিত্তিতে "এরিয়া ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)" পদে নিয়োগের জন্য আবেদনপত্র আহবান করা হচ্ছে। পদের বিবরণ:  "এরিয়া ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)" দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত এরিয়া অধীনস্থ শাখাসমূহে সংস্থার পরিকল্পনা ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুসারে ঋণ ও আর্থিক সেবা কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা, বাস্তবায়ন তদারকি এবং লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন নিশ্চিত করবেন। পাশাপাশি শাখাসমূহের লাভজনকতা বৃদ্ধি, কার্যক্রমের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখা, প্রশাসনিক ও কর্মী ব্যবস্থাপনা, আর্থিক ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং কর্মী প্রশিক্ষণেও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা রাখবেন। এই পদে দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত ব্যক্তি জোনাল ম্যানেজার, সহকারী পরিচালক এবং মাইক্রোফিন্যান্স বিভাগীয় প্রধানের নিকট বিপোর্টেবল থাকবেন। চাকরির প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ: বিজনেস প্লান অনুযায়ী অধীনস্থ প্রতিটি শাখার জন্য বার্ষিক ও মাসিক লক্ষ্যমাত্রা (সদস্য সংখ্যা বৃদ্ধি, ঋণ বিতরণ ও আদায়) নির্ধারণ করে দেওয়া এবং নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যে প্রতিটি শাখার লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জিত হচ্ছে কি না, তা নিয়মিত তদারকি করা। প্রতিটি শাখার বকেয়া ঋণের (Overdue) হার নিয়ন্ত্রণে রাখা এবং খেলাপি ঋণ আদায়ে শাখা ব্যবস্থাপককে কৌশলগত পরামর্শ দেওয়া। নিয়মিত বিভিন্ন সমিতি বা কেন্দ্র পরিদর্শন করে মাঠ কর্মীদের কাজের স্বচ্ছতা এবং ঋণের সঠিক ব্যবহার যাচাই করা। এরিয়া ম্যানেজারের অনুমোদন সীমার ঋণের আবেদনগুলো যাচাই করে অনুমোদনের সুপারিশ করা। শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক ও কর্মীদের কাজের মূল্যায়ন করা এবং তাদের পেশাদারিত্ব নিশ্চিত করা। কর্মীদের মধ্যে কাজের সুষম বণ্টন এবং প্রয়োজনে এক শাখা থেকে অন্য শাখায় কর্মী বদলির সুপারিশ করা। শাখা পর্যায়ের যেকোনো অভ্যন্তরীণ দ্বন্দ্ব বা শৃঙ্খলাজনিত সমস্যা সমাধান করা। প্রতিটি শাখার ক্যাশ ও ব্যাংকের লেনদেন নিয়মিত পরীক্ষা করা যাতে কোনো আর্থিক অনিয়ম না ঘটে। অভ্যন্তরীণ অডিট দলের পর্যবেক্ষণ অনুযায়ী ত্রুটিগুলো সংশোধনের ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া। প্রতিটি শাখার অপারেশনাল খরচ (General Expenses) বাজেটের মধ্যে রাখা নিশ্চিত করা। প্রতিটি শাখার অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট সংগ্রহ করে তা সমন্বিত আকারে ঊর্ধ্বতন কতৃপক্ষকে পাঠানো। ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষের সিদ্ধান্তগুলো মাঠ পর্যায়ে বাস্তবায়ন করা। শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক ও মাঠ কর্মীদের দক্ষতার উন্নয়নে হাতে-কলমে ছোটখাটো প্রশিক্ষণের ব্যবস্থা করা। স্থানীয় প্রশাসন, গণ্যমান্য ব্যক্তি এবং ব্যাংকের সাথে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের অন্যান্য সামাজিক কর্মসূচি (যেমন: স্বাস্থ্যসেবা, শিক্ষা বা সচেতনতা বৃদ্ধি) মাঠ পর্যায়ে সফলভাবে বাস্তবায়ন করা।
