job_description: The HRM Officer will support AID-COMILLA in maintaining an effective, transparent, accountable and professional human resource management system. The position will be responsible for recruitment and selection, staff records, contracts, attendance and leave management, performance management, staff welfare, capacity development, HR policy implementation and compliance with organizational policies and applicable labour laws of Bangladesh. Key Responsibilities A. Recruitment and Selection Prepare and update job descriptions in consultation with relevant departments. Develop vacancy announcements and coordinate recruitment processes. Receive, screen and shortlist applications against approved criteria. Arrange written tests, interviews and other selection processes. Maintain proper recruitment documentation and recruitment records. Ensure recruitment is based on merit, fairness, transparency and equal opportunity. Coordinate reference and background checks where applicable. Prepare appointment letters, employment contracts and joining documentation. B. Staff Records and HR Administration Maintain updated and confidential personnel files for all employees. Maintain HR databases, staff lists and personnel information. Monitor staff contracts, probation periods, renewals and extensions. Maintain records of attendance, leave, transfer, promotion, resignation and separation. Issue HR-related letters and certificates as authorized. Ensure proper filing and safe custody of HR documents. C. Attendance, Leave and Benefits Monitor staff attendance and leave records. Maintain monthly leave and attendance summaries. Coordinate staff benefits and entitlements in accordance with AID-COMILLA policies. Support administration of provident fund, gratuity, insurance and other applicable benefits. Coordinate with Finance regarding payroll-related HR information and changes. D. Performance Management Support the implementation of staff performance appraisal systems. Coordinate annual and probationary performance evaluations. Maintain performance appraisal records. Support supervisors in developing staff performance improvement plans. Identify staff capacity-building needs based on performance assessments. E. Staff Capacity Development Assess training and development needs in consultation with programme and departmental managers. Prepare annual HR/training plans. Coordinate staff orientation, induction and refresher training. Maintain training records and staff development databases. Promote continuous professional development and learning within the organization. F. HR Policy and Compliance Support implementation and periodic review of AID-COMILLA's HR policies and procedures. Ensure HR practices comply with organizational policies and applicable laws and regulations of Bangladesh. Advise management and staff on HR rules, procedures, benefits and employment conditions. Promote fair, respectful and non-discriminatory workplace practices. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive personnel information. G. Employee Relations and Staff Welfare Support positive employer–employee relationships. Address routine staff concerns and refer complex matters to senior management. Assist in resolving workplace grievances in accordance with organizational procedures. Promote staff welfare, motivation, teamwork and a healthy working environment. Support implementation of safeguarding, protection, prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA), gender equality and workplace conduct requirements. H. Separation and Exit Management Coordinate resignation, termination, retirement and other staff separation procedures. Conduct or coordinate exit interviews. Ensure clearance and handover procedures are properly completed. Coordinate final HR documentation and benefits with Finance and Administration. Maintain accurate separation records. I. HR Reporting Prepare periodic HR reports for management. Provide staff strength, turnover, recruitment, training, leave and other HR statistics. Support project teams in preparing HR information required by donors and partners. Ensure HR documentation is available for audits, monitoring visits and organizational assessments. Safeguarding and Code of Conduct The HR Officer will contribute to maintaining a safe, inclusive and respectful workplace. The position will ensure that HR processes incorporate AID-COMILLA's safeguarding, child protection, PSEA, gender equality, anti-harassment, non-discrimination and code-of-conduct requirements. The HR Officer must maintain strict confidentiality and demonstrate professional integrity when handling staff complaints, grievances and personnel information. Timely maintenance of attendance and leave records. Compliance with HR policies and procedures. Timely completion of staff contracts and renewals. Effective coordination of performance appraisal processes. Implementation of staff training and development activities. Timely submission of HR reports. Staff satisfaction and effective handling of HR-related concerns. Compliance with safeguarding, PSEA and workplace conduct requirements. Working Relationships Internal:  Executive Director, senior management, programme/project managers, Finance, Administration, Monitoring and other departmental staff. External:  Government authorities, auditors, consultants, donors/partners and other relevant stakeholders as required. General Responsibilities The HR Officer will perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Executive Director or designated supervisor that are consistent with the position and organizational objectives. AID-COMILLA is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a professional workplace based on merit, dignity, inclusion, accountability and respect.

Monitor whether corrective actions are actually effective instead of simply closing issues on paper. Identify recurring defects and implement systemic preventive measures. Establish mechanisms to prevent the same defect from occurring in other lines, styles or factories. Conduct regular QC calibration and defect-identification exercises. Develop training programs based on actual factory defect trends. Strengthen self-inspection, inline inspection, end-line inspection and finishing inspection systems. Quality Control from Cutting to Shipment Ensure effective quality control throughout the complete manufacturing process: Fabric → Cutting → Printing/Embroidery → Sewing → Washing → Finishing → Packing → Final Inspection → Shipment The candidate should be capable of establishing effective control points at every stage and ensuring that quality issues are identified and controlled before reaching the next process. Must be able to analyze: DHU Defect % Defects per 100 pieces First Pass Yield RFT – Right First Time Rework % Rejection % Alteration % Customer complaints Final inspection results Inline defect trends QC detection efficiency Line-wise quality performance Style-wise quality performance Factory-wise quality performance The candidate should be capable of converting quality data into specific actions and measurable improvements. One of the Project’s outputs calls for the for improvement in the process and outcomes of dispute resolution. The Wing will provide training and education programs to paralegals and federation leaders on conflict resolution techniques, labour law, and understanding rights and responsibilities in the workplace, as well as offer legal assistance and representation to workers and workers organisation involved in disputes with employers. The Dispute Resolution Wing will serve as the depository for data and case management. The Programme Officer will be responsible for managing the Dispute Resolution Wing of the WRC. job_description: The Officer-Billing  is responsible for managing the end-to-end billing cycle for  Inpatient (IPD), Outpatient Diagnostic Tests (OPD), and Admissions.  This role involves accurate processing of patient billing using the hospital’s software system, ensuring timely invoicing, payment reconciliation, and coordination with clinical and administrative departments. The officer ensures billing accuracy, compliance with hospital policies, and provides courteous support to patients throughout the billing process. Key Responsibilities: IPD (Inpatient Department) Billing: Ensure final bills are prepared accurately and completely at the time of patient discharge , avoiding any discrepancies or omissions. Generate and manage inpatient bills  using the hospital billing software throughout the patient’s stay. Update patient bills regularly  based on all medical services utilized, including doctor visits, lab tests, surgical procedures, medications, and consumables. Coordinate closely with nursing, pharmacy, diagnostics, and other clinical departments  to ensure all chargeable services are captured and billed. Work under tight timelines to complete discharge formalities smoothly, ensuring patient satisfaction and billing transparency. OPD (Outpatient Diagnostic Services) Billing: Accurately process and generate bills  for outpatient diagnostic tests, including pathology, radiology, and other investigations using hospital software. Verify doctor's prescriptions and test requisitions carefully  before initiating billing to ensure correctness. Collect complete patient information and test details , entering all data accurately into the billing system. Politely guide patients through payment procedures , clarify billing queries, and assist them in understanding the process for report collection and delivery. Maintain a courteous and professional attitude to enhance patient experience during outpatient visits. Admission Billing: Politely counsel patients and their attendants  regarding admission processes, estimated costs, deposit requirements, and billing procedures. Initiate billing for newly admitted patients  through the hospital software, ensuring timely and accurate registration. Verify and input patient records, admission details, deposit amounts, and initial service charges  into the system. Coordinate closely with the Admission Desk and relevant departments  to receive real-time updates on new admissions, cancellations, or changes in admission status. Ensure all billing entries are aligned with hospital policies and financial protocols. Software-Based Operations: Operate hospital billing software for data entry, charge posting, invoice generation, and receipt printing. Troubleshoot minor software issues and escalate technical concerns to the IT team. Maintain accurate and timely electronic billing records and backup logs. Payment & Reconciliation: Accept and record various types of payments (cash, card, bKash, insurance, corporate). Issue receipts and reconcile daily collections with the accounts department. Maintain proper documentation for insurance and credit clients. Reporting & Documentation: Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly billing and collection reports. Ensure that all documents are filed systematically (both digital and hard copies). Submit required data to Finance and Management on time. Patient Interaction & Support: Provide billing-related assistance to patients and their attendants with courtesy and clarity. Respond to queries regarding billing discrepancies, payment plans, or pending dues. Maintain professionalism and patient confidentiality at all times. Compliance & Coordination: Follow hospital policies, financial guidelines, and SOPs strictly. Work closely with departments such as Reception, Diagnostics, Finance, and Medical Records. Adhere to shift schedules (morning/evening/night) as per duty roster.

apply_hard_copy: আবেদনের নিয়ম: আগ্রহী প্রার্থীদের আবেদনপত্রের সঙ্গে পূর্ণাঙ্গ জীবনবৃত্তান্ত (CV), সম্প্রতি তোলা ২ (দুই) কপি পাসপোর্ট সাইজের রঙিন ছবি, শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা, বাংলাদেশ ফার্মেসি কাউন্সিলের বৈধ ও হালনাগাদ রেজিস্ট্রেশন সনদ, অভিজ্ঞতার সনদপত্র (প্রযোজ্য ক্ষেত্রে), এবং জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্রসহ প্রয়োজনীয় সকল কাগজপত্রের ১ম শ্রেণীর গেজেটেড কর্মকর্তা কর্তৃক সত্যায়িত ফটোকপি সংযুক্ত করে আগামী ২০/০৯/২০২৬ খ্রি. তারিখের মধ্যে অফিস চলাকালীন সময়ে নিম্নস্বাক্ষরকারীর নিকট পৌঁছাতে হবে।আবেদন ফি: আবেদন ফি বাবদ ৩০০/- (তিনশত) টাকা (অফেরতযোগ্য) পে-অর্ডারের মাধ্যমে অথবা জিয়া হার্ট ফাউন্ডেশনের হিসাব বিভাগে জমা দিয়ে প্রাপ্ত রশিদের কপি আবেদনপত্রের সঙ্গে সংযুক্ত করতে হবে।অসম্পূর্ণ, ত্রুটিপূর্ণ এবং বিলম্বে প্রাপ্ত আবেদন বাতিল বলে গণ্য হবে।অভিজ্ঞদের ক্ষেত্রে অগ্রাধিকার দেয়া হবে।বেতন জিয়া হার্ট ফাউন্ডেশনের বেতন কাঠামো অনুযায়ী/আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে নির্ধারণ করা হবে।বাছাইকৃত প্রার্থীদের মৌখিক/লিখিত (প্রযোজ্য ক্ষেত্রে) পরীক্ষায় অংশ গ্রহণের জন্য মোবাইল ফোনের মাধ্যমে জানানো হবে।সকল ক্ষেত্রে কর্তৃপক্ষের সিদ্ধান্তই চূড়ান্ত বলে গণ্য হবে।(বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য: শুধুমাত্র বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে উল্লেখিত যোগ্যতা ও শর্তাবলী পূরণকারী প্রার্থীদের আবেদন করার জন্য অনুরোধ করা যাচ্ছে। প্রাথমিক বাছাই শেষে কেবল যোগ্য বিবেচিত প্রার্থীদের সাক্ষাৎকারের জন্য আহ্বান করা হবে।)

Asgar Ali Hospital offers all-inclusive state-of-the-art medical & healthcare services with up-to-date facilities which are exclusively managed by well-reputed medical professionals, skilled nurses and technicians from home and abroad. It`s main focus is to provide affordable Healthcare Services of International Standard through continuous innovation and improvement of facilities and convenience.

Studies have shown that no medical procedure is absolutely hazard free, but can be alleviated to a great extent, thus considering the reality we meticulously follow Patient Safety Protocols suggested by `International Patient Safety Goals` (IPSG), `Total Quality Management` (TQM) and `Infection Control Program` to ensure the safety of each patient of Asgar Ali Hospital. Our motivated and professionally skilled workforce along with state-of-the-art equipment has constructed a congenial infrastructure to cater the health needs of our patients.

In Asgar Ali Hospital, we do believe in Human Touch which comes as cherished gift not from our Consultants only but also from every staff around. Together we strive to create HOPE inside our Patients minds and make them feel special, loved and cared. Therefore with help of our healthcare experts, we are working relentlessly on our people in developing the right kind of attitude and empathy needed to nurture the ailing body and soul because "Every single Life is precious".

Understand the proper use of fire extinguishers and fire response actions and internal/external disaster plans and procedures, and evacuation procedures and participates in safety training. Follows and practice correct hand washing technique. Understands and be aware of appropriate personal protective equipment and uses same in practice. Be aware of the Hospital’s Hazardous Waste Management System:            a. Appropriately segregates waste at the point of origin.            b. Discards waste in appropriate bags, receptacles, etc.   Performs all other tasks as required by the department.

Recruitment & Selection Process
আমাদের selection process practical ability-এর ওপর গুরুত্ব দেয়।
Step 1 - Application & Initial Screening
CV/application review-এর পরে shortlisted candidate-দের সঙ্গে initial communication/phone screening করা হতে পারে।
এখানে communication, job understanding, availability এবং basic professional behaviour দেখা হবে।
Step 2 - 3-Day System Familiarization & Practical Assessment
Selected candidate-দের একটি controlled test/UAT system-এ temporary access দেওয়া হবে।
Candidate প্রায় ৩ দিন সময় পাবেন system explore এবং শিখতে।
Sample/test data ব্যবহার করে candidate-কে বিশেষভাবে বুঝতে হবে:
• Search
• Booking/order handling
• Payment-related operation
• Trip management
• Operational records
• Exception handling
এর পরে structured practical assessment নেওয়া হবে।
আমরা শুধু candidate কোথায় click করেন তা দেখব না; candidate কীভাবে situation বুঝে decision নেন সেটিও মূল্যায়ন করা হবে।
Step 3 - Security & Integrity Assessment
Security এবং Integrity আলাদাভাবে evaluate করা হবে।
Scenario-based situation ব্যবহার করে দেখা হতে পারে candidate কীভাবে decision নেন যখন:
• customer urgent
• information incomplete
• booking information পরিবর্তিত
• payment mismatch
• sensitive information requested
• shortcut নেওয়ার pressure
• normal process এবং convenience-এর মধ্যে conflict
Operational assessment ভালো হলেও Security & Integrity standard independently pass করতে হবে।
Critical security/integrity violation final selection থেকে disqualification-এর কারণ হতে পারে।

job_description: Department:  QC / Laboratory / R&D Reports To : QA/QC Manager / Technical Manager Main Purpose of the Position To perform laboratory testing, quality control, product development, formulation trials, and technical evaluation of construction admixtures and cement grinding aids, ensuring that raw materials and finished products consistently meet company specifications and required performance standards. Raw Material Testing Inspect and test incoming raw materials according to approved specifications. Check physical and chemical properties of raw materials used for admixture and grinding-aid production. Approve or reject raw materials based on test results and company specifications. Maintain complete records of raw-material testing. Evaluate new raw materials and alternative suppliers. Report any abnormal or out-of-specification raw material to the QA/QC Manager. Construction Admixture Quality Control Test finished admixture products according to approved specifications and SOPs. Perform tests such as appearance, density/specific gravity, pH, solids content, viscosity, and other applicable parameters. Conduct concrete/mortar performance tests where required. Check admixture dosage and its effect on concrete performance. Evaluate workability/slump, slump retention, setting time, water reduction, and compressive strength as applicable to each product. Check batch-to-batch consistency. Release finished products only after required QC tests are completed and approved. Cement Grinding Aid Testing Conduct laboratory evaluation of cement grinding-aid products. Test different grinding-aid formulations and dosages. Evaluate the effect of grinding aid on cement grinding performance. Monitor cement properties such as fineness, setting time, strength development, and other applicable parameters. Conduct comparative trials against existing products or competitor/reference products when required. Maintain records of grinding-aid trials and test results. Assist the technical team in optimizing grinding-aid dosage and formulation. Product Development & R&D Assist in development of new construction admixture and cement grinding-aid formulations. Conduct laboratory-scale formulation trials. Optimize formulations for performance, stability, and cost. Evaluate new chemicals and raw materials for potential use. Maintain formulation and trial records. Conduct stability and compatibility studies where required. Support scale-up from laboratory trial to production batch. Keep formulation information confidential. Production Quality Control Collect samples from production batches according to approved sampling procedures. Perform in-process and final-product testing. Communicate laboratory results to the Production and QA/QC teams. Identify quality deviations during production. Assist in investigating the causes of quality problems. Recommend corrective action based on laboratory findings. Monitor consistency between laboratory trial batches and production batches. Concrete & Mortar Testing Prepare concrete/mortar test mixes according to approved mix designs. Conduct admixture dosage optimization. Evaluate slump and slump retention. Monitor setting time where applicable. Prepare specimens for compressive-strength testing. Compare performance at different admixture dosages and formulations. Maintain proper sample identification and testing records. Assist during customer/site trials when required. Cement Testing Conduct laboratory cement testing related to grinding-aid performance. Prepare cement samples for laboratory evaluation. Test relevant cement properties according to approved methods. Compare cement performance with and without grinding aid. Maintain accurate records of cement and grinding-aid trials. Assist in troubleshooting cement-performance issues. Laboratory Management Maintain laboratory cleanliness and proper housekeeping. Maintain laboratory equipment in good working condition. Check calibration status of laboratory instruments. Arrange calibration and maintenance when required. Maintain chemicals, reagents, consumables, and laboratory equipment inventory. Ensure proper labeling and storage of chemicals and samples. Maintain retain samples as required. Ensure proper disposal of chemical and laboratory waste. Documentation & Reporting Maintain daily laboratory test records. Prepare raw-material and finished-product test reports. Prepare Certificates of Analysis (COA) where applicable. Maintain batch-wise QC records. Maintain R&D formulation and trial records. Prepare laboratory trial reports and comparative test reports. Immediately report abnormal or out-of-specification results to management. Maintain proper traceability of samples and test results. Customer Technical Support Assist in investigating customer complaints related to product performance. Analyze customer samples where required. Support technical/customer service teams during field trials. Assist with admixture dosage recommendations based on laboratory results. Participate in customer cement/grinding-aid trials when required. Prepare technical test reports for customer trials. Safety Responsibilities Follow laboratory safety procedures and company HSE requirements. Use appropriate PPE when handling chemicals. Handle, store, and dispose of chemicals safely. Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS/MSDS) where required. Immediately report laboratory accidents, chemical spills, or unsafe conditions. Ensure laboratory activities are conducted in a safe and controlled manner. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The Lab Chemist will be evaluated based on: Accuracy and reliability of laboratory test results. Timely completion of QC testing. Consistency of finished-product quality. Successful formulation and R&D trials. Reduction of production quality problems. Effectiveness of technical troubleshooting. Accuracy and completeness of laboratory documentation. Proper maintenance and calibration of laboratory equipment. Successful support of customer/site trials. Compliance with laboratory safety and company SOPs.

বিশ্লেষণ করা এবং স্থানীয় পণ্যের চাহিদা, উৎপাদন/ক্রয় ও বিক্রয় পরিকল্পনা সংক্রান্ত তথ্য বিশ্লেষণ ও উপস্থাপন করা। নির্দিষ্ট এলাকাগুলোতে ভালো সম্ভাবনাময় ব্যবসাগুলোর একটি তালিকা তৈরি করা এবং তা নিয়মিত হালনাগাদ রাখা। ব্যবসায়িক প্রবৃদ্ধি কৌশল, কার্যক্রম উন্নয়ন এবং সম্প্রসারণের সুযোগ তৈরিতে উদ্যোক্তাদের সহায়তা প্রদান করা। বিভিন্ন উৎপাদন/বিপণন প্রতিষ্ঠানের সাথে লেনদেনের ধরন ও ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক স্থাপন বিষয়ে উদ্যোক্তাদের সাথে আলোচনা করা এবং স্থানীয় ব্যবসায়িক নেতৃবৃন্দ, আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান, সেবা প্রদানকারী, বাজার সংশ্লিষ্ট প্রতিষ্ঠান ও প্রাসঙ্গিক ইকোসিস্টেম অংশীজনদের সাথে সম্পর্ক গড়ে তোলা ও বজায় রাখা। ব্যবসায়িক পণ্যের সম্ভাব্য ক্রয়ের উৎস এবং বিক্রয়ের বাজার সম্পর্কে উদ্যোক্তাকে সামগ্রিক ধারণা প্রদান করা। সম্ভাব্য ব্যবসায়িক মূলধনের পরিমাণ বিশ্লেষণ করা, অর্থায়নের সুযোগ ও শর্তাবলী নিয়ে উদ্যোক্তাদের সাথে আলোচনা করা, এবং নির্বাচিত উদ্যোগসমূহের জন্য প্রবৃদ্ধি মূলধন ও ইক্যুইটি বিনিয়োগের মূল্যায়ন, নথিভুক্তকরণ ও পর্যবেক্ষণে সহায়তা করা। ব্যবসা পরিচালনার জন্য প্রাসঙ্গিক সকল আইনগত কাগজপত্র (ট্রেড লাইসেন্স/টিআইএন/বিআইএন/আইআরসি/ইআরসি/ব্যাংক হিসাব লেনদেন ইত্যাদি) সম্পর্কে উদ্যোক্তাদের তথ্য প্রদান করা। সম্ভাবনাময় উদ্যোক্তাদের ব্যবসায়িক প্রস্তাবনা প্রস্তুত ও উপস্থাপন করা। কার্যকর পোর্টফোলিও ব্যবস্থাপনার জন্য উদ্যোগের কার্যক্রম, মূলধন ব্যবহার, উদ্যোক্তার অগ্রগতি এবং মূল ব্যবসায়িক সূচকসমূহ পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। মূলধন আদায় এবং বিনিয়োগকৃত তহবিলের যথাযথ ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করতে পোর্টফোলিওর কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা এবং উদ্যোক্তাদের সাথে যোগাযোগ রক্ষা করা। উদ্যোগ পোর্টফোলিওর মধ্যে ঝুঁকি, ব্যবসায়িক চ্যালেঞ্জ এবং সহায়তার প্রয়োজনীয়তা চিহ্নিত করা এবং প্রয়োজনে বিষয়টি উর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষের নজরে আনা। প্রশিক্ষণ, উদ্যোক্তা উন্নয়ন কর্মশালা, মেন্টরিং কার্যক্রম, নেটওয়ার্কিং ইভেন্ট এবং ইকোসিস্টেম সংশ্লিষ্ট উদ্যোগ সমন্বয় ও সহায়তা করা। উদ্যোগের অগ্রগতি পর্যবেক্ষণ এবং ব্যবসায়িক প্রবৃদ্ধি, চ্যালেঞ্জ ও সহায়তার প্রয়োজনীয়তা নথিভুক্ত করার জন্য নিয়মিত মাঠপর্যায়ে পরিদর্শন করা। উদ্যোক্তা সম্পৃক্তকরণ, পোর্টফোলিও কার্যক্রম, মূলধন ব্যবহার, মাঠ পরিদর্শন এবং কর্মসূচির কার্যক্রমের যথাযথ রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা। নিয়মিত মাঠ প্রতিবেদন, উদ্যোগের কার্যক্রম হালনাগাদ, কেস স্টাডি এবং কার্যক্রম সংক্রান্ত নথিপত্র প্রস্তুত করা। কর্মসূচির কার্যক্রম সময়মতো ও কার্যকরভাবে বাস্তবায়ন নিশ্চিত করতে অভ্যন্তরীণ দলসমূহের সাথে ঘনিষ্ঠভাবে সমন্বয় সাধন করা। লাইন ম্যানেজার বা ব্যবস্থাপনা কর্তৃক অর্পিত অন্য যেকোনো কাজ সম্পাদন করা।

job_description: ABOUT OLYMPIA Olympia International is an international apparel business working across the UK, Europe, North America and the Middle East. We specialise in developing and supplying commercial fashion products for major international retailers, particularly within the off-price sector. Our product categories include T-shirts, polos, sweatshirts, hoodies, Henleys, knit tops and other casualwear across a portfolio of owned and licensed brands. We operate through teams in London and Bangladesh and work with a network of manufacturing partners across Bangladesh, China and other sourcing markets. As the business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Knit Merchandising Manager to take responsibility for our knit merchandising operation in Bangladesh. THE ROLE This is a senior, hands-on merchandising position responsible for managing the complete knit product and order lifecycle — from initial development and costing through sampling, order placement, production and final shipment. The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership rather than simply follow up orders. You will manage and develop the knit merchandising team in Bangladesh while working closely with Olympia's London Brand Leads, Bangladesh Product & Design team, garment technologists, factories, fabric mills, quality teams and production teams. A major part of the role is ensuring that information moves quickly and accurately between customers, the London office and factories. The objective is simple: Develop the right product, at the right price, place it with the right factory and deliver it on time and to the required quality standard. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone with approximately 8–12+ years' experience in knit apparel merchandising, including meaningful experience managing a merchandising team. Strong experience in products such as: - T-shirts - Polos - Sweatshirts - Hoodies - Henleys - Jersey tops - Fashion casualwear Experience working with international retailers, brands, buying offices or sourcing companies is strongly preferred. The successful candidate should demonstrate: - Excellent knowledge of knit garment production. - Strong fabric and garment construction knowledge. - Strong costing and price-negotiation ability. - Excellent understanding of critical-path management. - Strong factory management skills. - Ability to manage multiple customers and large numbers of styles simultaneously. - Strong problem-solving skills. - Excellent written and spoken English. - Strong Excel/reporting ability. - Ability to manage and develop junior team members. - Confidence communicating directly with overseas commercial teams and senior management. THE PERSON WE WANT Olympia is a fast-moving entrepreneurial business. We therefore need someone who thinks beyond the traditional merchandising role. We want someone who: Takes ownership. If something is going wrong, they act rather than wait for instructions. Communicates early. Bad news communicated early can normally be managed. Problems hidden until the last minute cannot. Understands product. They can look at a garment and understand how it should be made, where it should be made and approximately what it should cost. Is commercially minded. They understand that every sourcing and production decision ultimately affects whether Olympia can win and retain business. Can prioritise. Not every problem has the same commercial importance. Develops people. We want someone capable of building a strong merchandising department underneath them. Is comfortable with change. Olympia is growing and our systems, customers, factories and product categories will continue to evolve. SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE Within the first 6–12 months, we would expect the successful candidate to have: - Full control and visibility of the knit development and production pipeline. - Established clear accountability within the merchandising team. - Reduced late developments and production surprises. - Improved development turnaround times. - Strengthened factory costing and negotiation. - Improved communication between Bangladesh and London. - Developed stronger factory allocation and capacity planning. - Created reliable reporting for all live developments and orders. - Built a merchandising structure capable of supporting significant growth. This is an important leadership position within Olympia's Bangladesh operation and offers the opportunity to play a major role in the continued development of our international apparel business. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Product Development & Sampling Manage the knit development pipeline across multiple customers and brands. Responsibilities include: - Receive development briefs, tech packs and product requirements from Brand Leads and the Product/Design team. - Review developments before sending them to factories. - Identify suitable factories, fabrics, constructions and production methods. - Coordinate proto samples, fit samples, salesman samples, approval samples and other development requirements. - Ensure factories clearly understand all product comments and revisions. - Track outstanding developments and aggressively follow up delayed samples. - Work closely with designers and garment technologists to resolve technical or construction issues. - Ensure samples are commercially viable for bulk production. - Maintain visibility of the complete development pipeline. Speed of development is particularly important to Olympia's business model. 2. COSTING & COMMERCIAL MANAGEMENT Take responsibility for obtaining competitive and accurate factory pricing. This includes: - Request and negotiate factory quotations. - Understand garment consumption, fabric prices, CM, trims, washing, printing, embroidery and other cost components. - Challenge factory prices where necessary. - Compare pricing between suppliers. - Identify opportunities to engineer cost without compromising the required product. - Maintain accurate costing records. - Work with management and Brand Leads to achieve required target prices. The Merchandising Manager must have strong commercial judgement and understand what makes a product commercially viable. 3. ORDER PLACEMENT & FACTORY ALLOCATION Once orders are confirmed: - Review order details before placement. - Confirm quantities, colours, size ratios, delivery dates and product specifications. - Recommend the appropriate factory based on price, capability, capacity, compliance and delivery. - Ensure purchase orders and factory instructions are accurate. - Confirm factory acceptance and production capacity. - Identify potential production risks before orders are committed. Factories should never be allocated simply because they developed the original sample. Olympia expects the merchandising team to continuously identify the best production solution. 4. CRITICAL PATH & PRODUCTION MANAGEMENT Take ownership of the complete production critical path. Monitor and manage: - Fabric booking - Yarn/fabric availability - Lab dips - Strike-offs - Trims - Labels and packaging - Fit approvals - PP samples - Size sets - Testing - Bulk fabric - Cutting - Sewing - Printing/embroidery/washing - Finishing - Inspection - Packing - Shipment The merchandising team must identify delays before they become shipment problems. The manager will be expected to maintain clear visibility of every live order and escalate risks early. 5. FACTORY MANAGEMENT Build strong working relationships with Olympia's manufacturing partners. Responsibilities include: - Regular factory communication and visits. - Monitor factory performance. - Challenge unrealistic production plans. - Verify capacity before committing orders. - Resolve development and production problems quickly. - Work closely with factory merchandising and production teams. - Escalate serious delivery, quality or compliance risks. - Help identify and onboard new factories where required. The role requires someone comfortable dealing directly with factory owners and senior management when necessary. 6. TEAM MANAGEMENT Lead Olympia's knit merchandising team in Bangladesh. Responsibilities include: - Allocate customers, developments and orders across the team. - Set priorities and deadlines. - Review team workload. - Conduct regular order and development reviews. - Ensure critical paths are updated. - Coach junior merchandisers and develop their commercial understanding. - Improve working processes and accountability. - Ensure problems are escalated rather than hidden. The manager should build a department capable of managing significant growth without becoming dependent on one individual. 7. LONDON / BANGLADESH COORDINATION Act as one of the key operational links between the London commercial team and Bangladesh supply base. Work closely with Olympia's Brand Leads to: - Understand customer requirements. - Translate buyer/product comments into clear factory actions. - Provide accurate development and production updates. - Highlight commercial or delivery risks. - Support preparation for buyer meetings. - Ensure developments required for upcoming selling periods are completed on time. Communication must be concise, accurate and proactive. The London team should not need to repeatedly chase Bangladesh for updates. 8. PRODUCT, DESIGN & TECHNICAL COLLABORATION Work closely with Olympia's Bangladesh Product/Design leadership, designers, product developers and garment technologists. The Merchandising Manager will primarily own the commercial execution and order pipeline, while the Product/Design team leads collection and product creation. Both teams must work together on: - Fabric sourcing - Product development - Tech packs - Sampling - Cost engineering - Factory selection - Product feasibility - Approval processes - Production readiness The role therefore requires someone who understands product — not simply someone who can manage spreadsheets and production dates. 9. QUALITY & COMPLIANCE Work closely with Olympia's Quality, Technical and Compliance teams to ensure orders are placed and produced with suitable factories. The Merchandising Manager should: - Understand customer quality requirements. - Ensure testing requirements are communicated. - Ensure required approvals are completed before production. - Work with Quality teams when problems arise. - Ensure only appropriately approved/compliant factories are used for relevant customers. - Support corrective actions when factory issues are identified. 10. REPORTING & MANAGEMENT INFORMATION Maintain clear and accurate reporting covering: Development Pipeline - New developments - Sample status - Costing status - Outstanding approvals - Target completion dates Order Pipeline - Customer - Brand - Factory - Style - Quantity - Order value - Production status - Ex-factory date - Shipment date - Risks/issues Management should be able to understand the status of the entire knit business without having to individually chase merchandisers.

বায়োসিকিউরিটি ব্যবস্থা কার্যকর করতে সহযোগিতা করা। খামারের সকল কার্যক্রম নিরাপদ, স্বাস্থ্যসম্মত, পরিবেশবান্ধব ও টেকসইভাবে পরিচালনা নিশ্চিত করা। পশুর স্বাস্থ্য ও ভেটেরিনারি কেয়ার টিকাদান, কৃমিনাশক অন্যান্য স্বাস্থ্যগত সমস্যার প্রাথমিক লক্ষণ শনাক্ত করা। রোগ প্রতিরোধ, রোগ নির্ণয়, চিকিৎসা ও অন্যান্য স্বাস্থ্যসেবার জন্য ভেটেরিনারি চিকিৎসক/বিশেষজ্ঞদের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। টিকাদান, চিকিৎসা, অসুস্থতা, আঘাত ও অন্যান্য স্বাস্থ্যসংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রমের সঠিক রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা। প্রজনন ও উৎপাদনশীলতা ব্যবস্থাপনা প্রজনন চক্র, হিট ডিটেকশন, বাছুর প্রসব এবং কৃত্রিম প্রজনন (AI) কার্যক্রমের সঠিক রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ job_description: Job Summary: The  Physiotherapist  is responsible for helping patients recover from illness, injury, or surgery through physical therapy and rehabilitation. The position involves providing treatment to both  in-patients (IPD) —such as bed-bound or post-surgical patients—and  out-patients (OPD) —those visiting the physiotherapy center for ongoing care. The role includes assessing patients, planning and delivering therapy sessions, monitoring progress, and promoting recovery through exercise, manual therapy, and use of physiotherapy equipment. The physiotherapist works closely with doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure effective, safe, and patient-centered rehabilitation. Key Duties and Responsibilities: IPD (In-Patient Department) Visit patients in wards and provide physiotherapy at the bedside. Help post-operative patients start early movement and breathing exercises. Assist patients with walking, transfers, and safe mobility. Prevent complications like muscle stiffness or lung problems. Work with doctors and nurses to plan patient recovery. Prepare patients for discharge and guide them for home exercises. OPD (Out-Patient Department) Treat patients who come to the physiotherapy center with pain or mobility problems. Plan and provide exercises for back pain, arthritis, stroke, sports injury, etc. Use physiotherapy machines (ultrasound, heat therapy, TENS, etc.) when needed. Teach home exercise programs and posture correction. Keep records of patient progress and follow-up visits. General Responsibilities Assess and evaluate each patient before starting treatment. Keep detailed records of treatment given and progress made. Report patient progress to doctors and the head of the department. Maintain cleanliness and safety of physiotherapy equipment. Attend departmental meetings and training when required. Follow hospital rules, infection control, and patient confidentiality policies. Provide compassionate and respectful care to all patients.

Prepare and follow up on snag/punch lists. Ensure rectification of defective and incomplete works. Assist in testing, commissioning, documentation, and project handover. job_description: Position Overview The CCTV Technician will be responsible for  electrical wiring, CAT6 network cabling, CCTV camera installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and technical support . The technician must complete all work safely, neatly, professionally, and according to approved drawings, project specifications, client requirements, and company standards. Key Job Responsibilities Electrical Wiring & Power Connection Carry out electrical wiring for CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR, network switches, VMS servers, racks, monitors, and related security equipment. Install and connect electrical power cables from designated power sources to CCTV equipment. Install and connect MCBs, distribution boards, power sockets, switches, junction boxes, and power adapters where required. Route electrical cables through PVC/GI conduits, flexible conduits, cable trays, trunking, and approved pathways. Maintain proper phase, neutral, and earth connections. Provide proper grounding/earthing for CCTV equipment, racks, power supplies, and outdoor equipment where required. Check voltage supply before connecting sensitive CCTV and networking equipment. Identify and rectify loose connections, short circuits, power interruption, improper termination, and other electrical issues. Follow all applicable electrical safety procedures and client HSE requirements. CAT6 Network Cabling Install CAT6/CAT6A UTP network cable for IP cameras, NVRs, VMS servers, PoE switches, access control systems, and other network devices. Route CAT6 cables through cable trays, conduits, trunking, ceiling pathways, and wall conduits. Maintain proper separation between CAT6 data cables and electrical power cables. Maintain proper cable bending radius and avoid excessive pulling, crushing, kinking, or sharp bends. Label and identify cables from each camera location to the communication rack. Terminate RJ45 connectors, keystone jacks, patch panels, and network outlets. Follow T568A or T568B wiring standards consistently. Avoid unnecessary joints, splices, or damaged cable sections. Provide suitable service loops at camera and rack locations. CAT6 Testing & Certification Test completed CAT6 cables using professional network cable testers. Verify wire mapping, continuity, pair sequence, open circuit, short circuit, crossed pair, and other cable faults. Identify and rectify poor termination and cable connection problems. Support Fluke or equivalent cable certification testing where required. Maintain and submit cable testing reports where applicable. CCTV Camera Installation Install IP cameras, dome cameras, bullet cameras, PTZ cameras, thermal cameras, and other CCTV cameras. Install camera brackets, poles, junction boxes, outdoor housings, cable glands, conduits, and related accessories. Pull and terminate CAT6 and power cables for each camera. Perform camera alignment, focusing, field-of-view adjustment, and image positioning. Ensure outdoor camera connections are properly weatherproofed and protected. Verify camera mounting stability and professional cable management. CCTV Camera Troubleshooting Diagnose and resolve CCTV camera faults, communication problems, image problems, and power-related issues. Troubleshoot cameras that are offline, disconnected, showing video loss, receiving no PoE power, or experiencing intermittent connectivity. Troubleshoot blurred, distorted, noisy, flickering, black/blank, or poor-quality video. Troubleshoot IR/night-vision, date/time, recording, and configuration issues. Check camera power supply, PoE port, CAT6 cable, RJ45 termination, switch port, IP address, and network connectivity. Verify camera configuration including IP address, subnet mask, gateway, DNS, NTP, resolution, frame rate, bitrate, encoding, and recording settings. Troubleshoot duplicate IP and network communication issues. Check ONVIF or applicable camera protocol compatibility. Replace defective cameras, connectors, cables, PoE ports, power supplies, or other faulty components where required. Perform authorized camera reset, reconfiguration, firmware update, and NVR/VMS re-registration. Verify live view, recording, playback, remote viewing, and analytics after troubleshooting. Maintain proper troubleshooting and service records. NVR / DVR / VMS Troubleshooting Troubleshoot camera connection and recording problems in NVR, DVR, and VMS platforms. Add, remove, modify, and reconfigure cameras. Check recording schedules, storage status, HDD health, user permissions, and playback functionality. Troubleshoot communication between cameras, PoE switches, NVRs, servers, and monitoring workstations. Support remote viewing and network access configuration. Rack, Patch Panel & Switch Cabling Install and organize CAT6 cables inside network and CCTV racks. Terminate cables into patch panels and connect them to PoE/network switches using patch cords. Maintain accurate rack, patch-panel, and switch-port labeling. Perform professional cable dressing using Velcro straps, cable managers, and other accessories. Maintain proper separation between power and data cabling. Testing, Commissioning & Maintenance Test every CCTV camera and associated equipment after installation. Verify live view, recording, playback, camera coverage, night vision, remote access, and analytics functions. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR, VMS, PoE switches, racks, and cabling. Check connectors, cable conditions, power supplies, storage status, and network connectivity. Conduct final system testing before handover. Safety Responsibilities Follow company and client HSE requirements at all times. Attend mandatory HSE induction before working at client sites where applicable. Use appropriate PPE, including safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, safety harness, and eye protection. Follow safe procedures for electrical work, ladder use, scaffolding, and work-at-height activities. Maintain a clean and safe working environment. Documentation & Reporting Maintain camera installation records and cable identification schedules. Record camera IP addresses, locations, rack numbers, patch-panel ports, and switch ports. Prepare cable testing, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting reports. Report material shortages, defective equipment, site obstacles, and technical issues to the supervisor/project engineer. Assist in preparing as-built drawings and final handover documentation. Job Standard The selected technician must be able to independently perform or effectively support  electrical wiring, CAT6 cabling, CCTV camera installation, camera troubleshooting, NVR/DVR/VMS configuration, testing, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and technical service work  while maintaining professional quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.

 ১. পদের সারসংক্ষেপ 
 কমি শেফ কিচেন টিমের একটি প্রাথমিক কিন্তু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পদ, যেখানে কর্মরত ব্যক্তি শেফ দ্য পার্টি, সু শেফ এবং হেড শেফের তত্ত্বাবধানে খাদ্য প্রস্তুত, উপকরণ প্রস্তুতকরণ এবং কিচেনের দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনায় সহায়তা করবেন। 
 এই পদের মূল উদ্দেশ্য হলো প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মান, রেসিপি এবং স্বাস্থ্যবিধি অনুসরণ করে খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপগুলো সম্পন্ন করা, কিচেনের কার্যক্রমকে সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা এবং সিনিয়র শেফদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 ২. প্রধান দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য 
 ক) খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি সহায়তা 
 
 শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী বিভিন্ন খাদ্য উপকরণ প্রস্তুত করা (কাটা, ধোয়া, পরিমাপ করা ইত্যাদি)। 
 নির্ধারিত রেসিপি অনুযায়ী খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপে সহায়তা করা। 
 খাবারের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখতে সতর্কতা অবলম্বন করা। 
 খাবারের সঠিক উপস্থাপন নিশ্চিত করতে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 খ) কিচেন পরিচালনা ও পরিচ্ছন্নতা 
 
 কিচেনের নির্ধারিত কর্মস্থল পরিষ্কার, স্বাস্থ্যসম্মত ও সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা। 
 রান্নাঘরের যন্ত্রপাতি, সরঞ্জাম ও উপকরণ ব্যবহারের পর পরিষ্কার রাখা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নীতিমালা মেনে চলা। 
 
 গ) উপকরণ ব্যবস্থাপনা 
 
 খাদ্য উপকরণ সঠিকভাবে সংরক্ষণ ও ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। 
 উপকরণের সতেজতা ও গুণগত মান পরীক্ষা করা। 
 প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণের ঘাটতি হলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। 
 
 ঘ) টিমওয়ার্ক ও সহযোগিতা 
 
 কিচেন টিমের অন্যান্য সদস্যদের সাথে সমন্বয় রেখে কাজ করা। 
 সিনিয়র শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করা এবং তাদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 ব্যস্ত সময়ে দ্রুত ও দক্ষতার সাথে কাজ সম্পন্ন করা। 
 
 
 ৩. প্রয়োজনীয় যোগ্যতা ও দক্ষতা 
 
 কুলিনারি আর্টস বা ফুড প্রোডাকশন বিষয়ে প্রশিক্ষণ থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। 
 রেস্টুরেন্ট, ক্যাফে বা হোটেল কিচেনে  কমপক্ষে ১–২ বছরের অভিজ্ঞতা  থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার। 
 খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি, রান্নার মৌলিক কৌশল এবং কিচেন ব্যবস্থাপনা সম্পর্কে প্রাথমিক ধারণা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নিয়ম সম্পর্কে সচেতনতা। 
 দলগতভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা এবং দায়িত্বশীল মনোভাব। 
 দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ এবং পেশাদারিত্ব বজায় রাখার মানসিকতা। 
 
 
 ৪. কর্মপরিবেশ ও কর্মঘণ্টা 
 
 রান্নাঘরের পরিবেশে দীর্ঘ সময় দাঁড়িয়ে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে। 
 প্রয়োজনে শিফট ভিত্তিক কাজ, সপ্তাহান্তে বা বিশেষ দিনে কাজ করতে হতে পারে। 
 
 
 ৫. বেতন ও সুবিধা 
 
 প্রার্থীর যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে। 
 প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুবিধা প্রদান করা হবে।
